description: Description: Remote Our client is seeking a Knowledge Graph Architect to lead the architecture and technical strategy for a construction-focused ontology, knowledge graph, and AI knowledge platform. You will connect historical project and operational data across estimating, scheduling, project controls, field execution, equipment, cost, and lessons learned to create a reusable knowledge foundation that can support AI, GraphRAG, LLM, and agent-based applications. This role requires expertise in designing and building enterprise knowledge graphs and ontologies applied to modern AI use cases. Due to client requirements, applicants must be willing and able to work on a w2 basis. For our w2 consultants, we offer a great benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits, 401k with company matching, and life insurance. Rate: $100.00 to $120.00/hr. w2 JN -102026-109252 Responsibilities: Architect and develop an enterprise ontology and knowledge graph for complex construction and project data. Define relationships across projects, activities, estimates, schedules, cost codes, crews, equipment, quantities, production rates, risks, changes, and outcomes. Evaluate and incorporate relevant standards, including IFC, buildingSMART, LandInfra, and semantic web standards. Integrate enterprise data from multiple operational and project systems into the knowledge architecture. Design and guide GraphRAG, LazyGraphRAG, RAG, and AI agent architectures. Establish standards for ontology governance, provenance, entity resolution, cross-system mappings, and knowledge quality. Partner with domain SMEs, enterprise architecture, data engineering, AI engineering, and technology teams. Design experiments to evaluate whether structured enterprise knowledge improves AI answer quality compared with traditional RAG and LLM approaches. Experience Requirements: Strong experience in knowledge graph architecture, ontology development, semantic architecture, knowledge engineering, enterprise/data architecture, or AI/ML architecture. Hands-on experience working with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic modeling, or graph databases. Understanding of RAG/GraphRAG, LLMs, AI agents, and enterprise data integration. Experience defining relationships and mappings across complex, disparate enterprise data sources. Ability to translate complex business and operational concepts into scalable technical architectures. Strong communication skills and ability to work across both technical teams and business/domain SMEs.

description:
Are you interested in working directly for a single sponsor while having the security and additional career opportunities that working for a global CRO can bring? Our team says it’s the best of both worlds...

We are building our talent pipeline for 2027 and expect to have multiple opportunities throughout the year for experienced professionals in Clinical Statistical Programming at the Senior and Principal level. We anticipate hiring for up to 20 positions during calendar year 2027, with openings becoming available at different times based on client demand and business growth.

 

The Senior/Principal Statistical Programmer is responsible for serving as a technical and study programming lead across multiple compounds and/or studies within the Statistical Programming function, supporting client assets within a specific therapeutic area such as Oncology, Rare Disease, or Neuroscience.

The role requires strong hands-on statistical programming expertise, study leadership, and technical knowledge to ensure the quality, consistency, and timely delivery of statistical programming activities. The programmer will work closely with statisticians, clinical teams, data management, and other cross-functional stakeholders and may also provide technical oversight of outsourced programming activities.

Main Responsibilities & Technical Competencies

  • Serve as a lead statistical programmer for multiple studies and/or compounds, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of statistical programming activities.
  • Lead and execute statistical programming activities across clinical trials, from study start-up through database lock, reporting, and regulatory submission.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and executional excellence across programming deliverables for assigned studies.
  • Support programming activities for global regulatory submissions and responses to health authority questions.
  • Provide technical oversight and guidance for outsourced statistical programming activities, ensuring deliverables meet required quality, budget, and timeline expectations.
  • Develop, review, and validate high-quality statistical programming deliverables, including tables, listings, figures (TLFs), SDTM/ADaM datasets, and associated documentation such as Define-XML.
  • Provide technical expertise in SAS programming, including development, QC/validation, and documentation of statistical programs.
  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of SAS programming standards, SOPs, work instructions, and best practices.
  • Ensure study-related programming documentation is maintained in accordance with client processes and is inspection/audit ready.
  • Collaborate with statisticians and cross-functional teams to understand complex study designs, endpoints, and analysis requirements and translate them into robust programming solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other statistical programmers and contribute to the development of programming capabilities within the organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve programming processes, adopt innovative and efficient approaches, and support evolving and complex study design methodologies.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in statistical programming and contribute to technical decision-making within assigned studies and therapeutic areas.

 Behavioural Competencies Required

  • Collaborates effectively across functions and organizational boundaries.
  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactively seeks relevant stakeholder input and expertise to support effective decision-making.
  • Takes ownership and accountability for decisions, actions, successes, and challenges.
  • Demonstrates strong planning and organizational skills, effectively managing priorities, resources, and timelines.
  • Maintains a strong focus on quality, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Demonstrates a proactive approach to identifying risks, resolving issues, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Supports and coaches colleagues by sharing technical knowledge and best practices.

Knowledge & Experience

  • Strong proficiency in SAS programming within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO environment.
  • Strong understanding of CDISC standards, including SDTM and ADaM.
  • Hands-on experience with SDTM and ADaM specification, development, and programming.
  • Strong experience in TFL programming and reporting.
  • Experience supporting clinical trial reporting and/or regulatory submissions.
  • Experience working with complex clinical trial data and study designs.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership and independently manage programming activities across multiple studies.
  • 8+ years of statistical programming experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO environment supporting clinical development.
  • Experience in one or more of the following therapeutic areas is preferred: Oncology, Rare Disease, or Neuroscience.

Knowledge & Experience (preferred) 

  • R or other packages are desired;
  • Understand clinical data flow. Experience in NDA/sNDA submission is desired.

Education / Certifications (essential)

  • Bachelor or MSc in Statistics, Mathematics, or Scientific Discipline

Language(s) (essential)

  • English

Language(s) (preferred)

  • French

 

Who will you be working for?

About ClinChoice

ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO specializing in clinical development and functional solutions for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer health companies. We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.           

Our Company Ethos

Our mission drives our culture: to contribute to a healthier and safer world by accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative drugs and devices. Our employees are the most valuable company asset, and they are the fulcrum around which all ClinChoice activities are built, and close management and training are the core instruments to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology.   The success of these core values is evidenced by our low industry-average turnover rates.

ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent, guided by a commitment to diversity and inclusivity. Our employees come from very diverse backgrounds: gender, race, beliefs, and ethnicities. We recognize this is our strength and celebrate it.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Maritime delivers platforms, systems and integrated effects in the maritime domain. Autonomous vehicles are central to these capabilities, with sustained emphasis on endurance, autonomy and mission capability. In Australia, the team’s work centres on Dive-XL. The Australian program spans the platform, payloads, autonomy and the supporting enterprise required to field and sustain the capability, delivered with an Australian workforce and an Australian supply chain, in close partnership with the Commonwealth.

ABOUT THE JOB

As Account Director - Maritime you will support Anduril’s customer engagement for Dive-XL in Australia. You will be a key stakeholder in the Australian customer relationship and a principal voice of the customer within the product organisation, working across the Royal Australian Navy (RAN), Naval Shipbuilding and Sustainment Group (NSSG), Defence Science and Technology (DST) Group and the Commonwealth departments that shape, sponsor and fund the program. You will operate as part of a broader engagement team spanning Growth, Programs, Engineering and Contracts rather than as the sole interface to the customer. The role combines operational background, capability development experience and commercial judgement. You will be credible discussing autonomy behaviours and payload trade-offs with engineering teams, familiar with how capability requirements are developed, contested and funded within Defence, and conversant with the ASDEFCON framework through which intent becomes contracted scope. This is a senior, externally facing role in which your operational judgement and customer insight will directly inform how an autonomous undersea capability is defined, developed and deployed.

Internal Interfaces
Product Director, XL-AUV: You report to the Product Director and provide prioritised customer and operational input to the Dive-XL roadmap, ensuring that Australian requirements are represented in product decisions and that customer commitments remain consistent with the capability plan.

SEA1200 Program Director: The Account Director and the SEA1200 Program Director operate as a partnership across the same program. The Program Director owns contract execution and the delivery organisation that performs it; you own the customer interface, keeping the contract sold and creating the conditions to extend it. Both roles work from a shared understanding of commitments, delivery performance and customer expectations, and neither succeeds without the other.

Growth and Global Defence: You work with the Growth organisation and Anduril’s Global Defence teams to identify, qualify and support capture opportunities, aligning Australian pursuits with wider international campaigns and ensuring that positioning in Australia is consistent with the company’s global approach to allied undersea programs.

Engineering, Programs and Test and Evaluation: You provide the operational context behind requirements and represent the customer’s perspective in design, trials and acceptance discussions, so that engineering effort remains anchored to real warfighting problems.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Commonwealth Relationships: Contribute to Anduril’s engagement across the RAN, NSSG, and the Commonwealth departments that shape, sponsor and fund the program, from capability sponsors through to the operators who will take the vehicle to sea.
  • Engagement Rhythm: Support a disciplined cadence of briefings, capability forums, working groups and demonstrations across classified and unclassified environments, so that Anduril’s standing with the customer is institutional rather than personal.
  • Voice of the Customer: Act as a principal channel between the customer and Anduril, conveying customer intent within the company and representing our capability accurately outside it.
  • Employment Concepts: Contribute to the development of employment concepts and CONOPS for autonomous undersea capability in the Australian context, and to a shared understanding of how the RAN intends to operate the capability.
  • Operational Need into Product Requirement: Distil operational analysis, threat assessments and customer intent into clear, prioritised capability needs, and provide substantiated input to the Dive-XL roadmap in partnership with product and engineering leadership.
  • Capture Support: Support the growth path from current contracts toward fleet scale. Contribute to early requirement shaping and to responses to Commonwealth approaches to market, working with Growth, Global Defence, Programs, Contracts and Legal within the ASDEFCON environment.
  • Alignment to Product Strategy: Work with the Product Director to keep contract execution and customer commitments aligned to the capability roadmap, identifying and escalating misalignment early.
  • Trials and Demonstrations: Support customer engagement around trials, demonstrations and milestone events, ensuring that what is demonstrated is represented accurately and consistently.

description: Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10. About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/ Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward. Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care. Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in. What you'll do You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team. 1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use. Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement. Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text). Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable. Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input. Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions. 2. Clinical knowledge base Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records. Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships. Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them. Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts. Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database. Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows. By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product. What we're looking for We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other. Must-haves Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks. Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models. Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control. Working knowledge of databases and data modelling. Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing. Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints. Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters. Nice to have Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding. A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence. Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets). Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards. Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment. Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer. Probably not the right fit if You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective. You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day. This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team. description:
SumUp builds simple, affordable financial tools that help small businesses get paid, manage their money, and grow. Beyond payments, we offer a number of financial products - including business banking, card products, lending, and invoicing - giving merchants everything they need to manage their payments and finances in one place.

The Cards squad is a core part of that, owning the systems that power card issuing, lifecycle management, and transaction processing for merchants across Europe. We handle millions of card transactions every day, and we're now scaling those systems to support new product capabilities while laying the foundations for a more global, resilient platform. That's why we're growing the team and looking for a seasoned backend engineer who can take real ownership of complex, high-impact work. If you want to build systems that genuinely matter to small businesses and you're excited by the technical depth that comes with high-throughput, distributed architecture, this is the role for you.

🎥 Get a feel for our Berlin office here.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of backend services within the Cards EU domain, including observability, testing, and production support
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap by participating in architectural discussions and proposing solutions for complex, distributed systems challenges

  • Participate in incident reviews and the on-call rotation, taking accountability for the reliability of the services you build

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, API design, data modelling, and working with relational databases

  • Ability to take an ambiguous product problem, define the technical approach, and lead it through to implementation with minimal guidance
  • Comfort working across teams and communicating clearly in written and spoken English in a professional setting
  • Genuine curiosity about the product domain — comfortable applying a backend lens during feature refinement and thinking beyond the code to understand how your work shapes the user experience

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

  • 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
  • 🏃 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! About the role Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution. You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business. What you’ll be doing Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together. Drive a high volume of quality submissions from your panel. Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading. Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Build data-led growth plans for each account and follow them through. Support day-to-day trading so brokers win and keep business with Flock, keeping conversion and retention high. Work with underwriting, product and other teams across Flock towards shared growth goals. Use AI daily for broker research, meeting prep and pipeline analysis. What you’ll need At least five years managing broker relationships in insurance, with a strong reputation in the market. An existing network of broker contacts you can bring to Flock from day one. A strong understanding of the commercial broker market, competing carriers and how broker businesses work. A track record of beating revenue targets and working well with teams across a business. A consultative sales approach that matches Flock’s proposition to what each broker needs. Pace and energy: you move fast, spot opportunities and solve problems. Comfortable using AI at work and curious about where else it could help you win business. Nice to have: experience building broker networks in Commercial Motor Fleet, an active broker panel in commercial insurance, or a record of taking new technology or products to brokers. Benefits 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 Share Incentive Plan 📈 Workplace Pension 💰 Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options) Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵 Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣 £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓 £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻 This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, working with brokers across Bristol and the surrounding region, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. As long as you’re meeting brokers consistently each week, time at our Central London office, a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street, can be weekly or monthly. description:
Role:                Build and Test Automation Engineer
Department:    Engineering
Reports into:   Lead QA Engineer
Location:         London (hybrid)

ABOUT THE ROLE

disguise is looking for a software engineer who considers themselves a generalist programmer, specialising in build and test infrastructure. You will work on the path every change to our software takes, from commit to build to automated test results.

Our products design, sequence and control live productions across film and TV, broadcast, and live events. The code we ship runs in front of an audience, often with no second take, so the faster and more reliably we can tell an engineer their change is safe, the better our product is.

The goal is test results within two hours of every build, as the number of builds and tests keeps rising. You will deliver work across all of it: CI, the build, C++, Python and AWS.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Deliver work across the build and test pipeline: CI configuration, distributed builds, dependencies, installers and build agents
  • Run and scale the test grid across physical and virtual machines, with an eye on both speed and cost
  • Speed up test runs as test volume grows, splitting and parallelising suites and removing the bottlenecks you find
  • Build reporting across C++ unit tests and Python integration tests to guide development
  • Build AI-assisted development tools to increase productivity
  • Fix C++ and Python in the product where it gets in the way of building or testing, and extend the test framework's control libraries
  • Work closely with QA and software engineers, including reviewing their work

EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential:

  • Writing C++ in a professional environment
  • Python for tooling or test automation
  • CI/CD or DevOps tooling, such as TeamCity or an equivalent
  • AWS or another major cloud platform
  • Automated testing of real-time, graphics or hardware-dependent software
  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Desirable:

  • Distributed or cached C++ builds, such as FASTBuild, and package managers such as conan
  • Building on Windows with MSVC and Visual Studio
  • Git Action Script development experience
  • Code coverage and test-impact analysis tooling, such as OpenCppCoverage or coverage.py
  • GPU workloads in the cloud, machine images and infrastructure as code (for example Packer or Terraform)
  • PowerShell scripting
  • Using AI coding agents or LLMs in engineering workflows
  • Media server, real-time graphics or live events experience
  • An interest in what disguise does as a company

Skills, behaviours and values

  • Clear and concise communication, written and verbal
  • Methodical, with strong attention to detail
  • Able to work autonomously, and to ask for help early
  • Collaborative: you make the team better, not just the pipeline
  • Curious, and keen to expand what you know
  • Resilient enough to keep experimenting when the first approach fails

WHY JOIN DISGUISE

You’ll work on technology powering some of the most ambitious live productions and immersive experiences in the world — alongside talented engineers across multiple disciplines and time zones.

If you’re excited about cloud systems, real-time 3D tools, and building products that operate at global scale, we’d love to hear from you.

About Disguise

Disguise is the industry-leading platform sitting at the heart of a new era of visual experiences. One powerful integrated system of software, hardware and services to help create the next dimension of real-time spectacle.
We partner with the biggest entertainment brands and companies in the world to deliver the A-list of live music events, live TV broadcasts, immersive experiences, installations, theatre, film and TV production, corporate communications and brand product launches. Working with Disney, Snapchat, Netflix, ESPN, the Burj Khalifa, and Adele, Disguise is the number one partner delivering the next dimension of entertainment. 

Watch our showreel

Don’t Disguise your differences.

Innovation comes from everyone. We strive to create a workplace that reflects our diverse audience. We celebrate our people for their full authentic selves, and embrace uniqueness. Inclusion and Equity matter at Disguise. We create together and we create everywhere. 

 

Our values

  • Honest. We are real with ourselves and our clients and share our ideas with openness and transparency. 
  • Evolutionary. We innovate using our user’s ever-changing needs so our technology remains ahead-of-the-game.
  • Fearless. We take the best path, not the easiest, and innovate where it’s right, not where it’s simplest.
  • Resilience. We don’t give up until we find the right solution, even if it means going outside our remit.
  • Belong.  We create an environment where everyone feels like they belong and is empowered to do their best work.

 

Our benefits

  • We have a suite of globally relevant competitive benefits packages as we want to make sure we retain the best talent out there. Our benefits for every perm hire, globally include:
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off - with minimum time you must take set at 20% above statutory
  • Hybrid working between home and our offices (dependent on role and location)
  • Mental health and wellbeing support - subscription to the Calm app, mental health first-aid buddies, employee assistance programmes
  • Gig allowance - £400 (or local equivalent) to spend on tickets every year to immerse yourself in our industries
  • Belonging policies -  including (but not limited to) support for Parental, Fertility, Miscarriage, Menopause and Transitioning
  • Training, coaching & mentoring

Du kombinierst analytisches Denken, Business Development und kommerzielles Verständnis und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen. Deine Ideen sollen nicht nur auf dem Papier funktionieren – Du bringst sie in die Umsetzung und misst ihren tatsächlichen Impact. Dein Spielfeld Business Development & Growth Du analysierst die Entwicklung unserer Partner und identifizierst konkrete Wachstums- und Aktivierungspotenziale. Du untersuchst, warum bestimmte Partner erfolgreicher sind als andere und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen und Best Practices ab. Du entwickelst neue Ansätze, um die Nutzung unserer Finanzierungslösung bei Partnern zu steigern. Du erkennst Chancen frühzeitig und gehst diese proaktiv an. Du denkst über einzelne Partner hinaus und entwickelst Lösungen, die auf größere Teile unseres Partnernetzwerks übertragbar sind. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Umsetzung Deiner Ideen und misst deren Erfolg. Analytics & Problem Solving Du nutzt Daten und KPIs, um komplexe Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und relevante Insights zu gewinnen. Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund und fragst Dich nicht nur „Was passiert?“, sondern vor allem „Warum passiert es?“ und „Was können wir verändern?“ Du übersetzt Analysen in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen. Du erkennst Zusammenhänge und Muster und entwickelst daraus neue Lösungsansätze. Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Möglichkeiten, unser Partnergeschäft effizienter und skalierbarer zu machen. Du kannst zwischen Detailtiefe und strategischer Perspektive wechseln. Partner & Commercial Ownership Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu unseren Installateur-Partnern auf und verstehst deren Geschäftsmodelle und Vertriebsprozesse. Du bist Sparringspartner für Deine Partner und hilfst ihnen dabei, konkrete Business-Ziele zu erreichen. Du kannst analytische Erkenntnisse in überzeugende Empfehlungen übersetzen und unterschiedliche Stakeholder für Veränderungen gewinnen. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität und bist bereit, selbst in die Umsetzung zu gehen. Zusammenarbeit & Aufbau Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen. Du bringst Deine Erkenntnisse in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse und unseres Partnerangebots ein. Du hilfst dabei, Best Practices und skalierbare Strukturen aufzubauen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für neue Themen und treibst sie eigenständig von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem. Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. The Role We're looking for a Commissions & Targets Manager to own how our sales organisation is paid and how its targets are set. You'll run the commission process end to end, manage CaptivateIQ, handle complex cases, and run the quarterly target distribution for our sales reps. You'll shape our commission strategy with the Director of Revenue Operations. You'll also be the go-to person for two experienced commission analysts. It's not a line management role, but you'll guide the team on difficult cases. Payouts depend on accurate numbers delivered on fixed deadlines, so we need someone with strong attention to detail who prioritises well in a fast-moving team. This is an Individual Contributor role. What You'll Do First 90 days: Master our commission plans, workflows, and CaptivateIQ setup, and execute your first end-of-quarter close with support from the Director. First 6 months: Take full ownership of the end-of-quarter close and case escalations, and lead your first quarterly target distribution. First 12 months: Partner with the Director to shape our commission strategy while optimising the processes and system configurations you inherited. What Will You Be Doing? Commission Processes Manage the end-of-quarter commission process, from data validation and plan calculations to review, approvals and payout handover. Start with the Director's oversight and take full ownership of the process within your first two quarters. Define the end-of-quarter schedule: map all the activities, decide which to prioritise, identify what can be front-loaded ahead of quarter end, and build a plan that hits the deadlines and delivers quality results. During the close, make quick calls and reprioritise when things go wrong, flag risks before they affect payouts, and keep the process documented and auditable. Spot recurring errors and bottlenecks, and fix them at the source. Commission Cases & Team Support Act as the escalation point for complex or disputed commission cases, supporting the two commission analysts. Coach the analysts on case handling, resolve difficult cases and make clear, consistent and well-documented decisions. Identify patterns in the cases raised, and use them to improve plan rules, documentation and communication. Commission System Ownership Manage our commissions system, CaptivateIQ: plan configuration, data integrations, quarterly updates and access. Partner with the Sales Operations, Finance and Data team on data quality and any system changes. Test and validate changes before each close, so that calculations are accurate and reproducible. Commission Strategy Work with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the commission strategy, including plan design, rules and how they support company goals. Analyse plan performance and its effect on sales behaviour, and bring a point of view on what to change. Prepare the commission plan updates for each planning period and communicate them clearly to sales and finance stakeholders. Quarterly Target Distribution Run the target setting cycle each quarter, with clear methodology and timelines, and explain the outcomes to sales leaders. Make sure any outlier or special case target adjustments are handled before the targets are published. Handle target questions and adjustments in a fair and consistent way. What Will You Need to Succeed? Strong experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Compensation or a similar role, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level. Hands-on experience running commission processes for a quota-carrying sales organisation, including end-of-quarter closes. Experience administering a commissions system (CaptivateIQ or a similar tool such as Qobra) is preferred but not required. Exceptional attention to detail and the discipline to deliver accurate results on fixed deadlines. A strong ability to improve processes: you spot what is manual, error-prone or slow, and fix it at the source. Ability to prioritise well and make fast, accurate calls in a fast-moving, deadline-driven environment. Strong analytical skills. Experience setting or contributing to sales targets and quotas is a plus. Good judgment and strong stakeholder management, including handling sensitive conversations about pay with sales leaders, finance and ICs. Experience guiding or coaching other analysts. Clear written and verbal communication in English. Experience working with global or multi-region teams is a plus. What We Offer? 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays. An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing. A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use. Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office. Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk. Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party. Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones. Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about. Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected. A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk. Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs. AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate. #LI-Hybrid Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Konzepte prüfen: Ideen mit den beteiligten Teams auf Umsetzbarkeit prüfen, inklusive wiederverwendbarer Sets und schneller Umbauten. Testen und auswerten: Themen auf Nachfrage und Ticketverkäufe testen, Performance und Werbebudget analysieren und Empfehlungen ableiten: ausbauen, anpassen oder verwerfen. Entscheiden: Ergebnisse präsentieren, gemeinsam die nächsten Winner-Topics bestimmen und Learnings festhalten. Magische Erlebnisse bei Dreamlight Labs Dreamlight Labs entwickelt und produziert immersive Live-Erlebnisse, die Schauspiel, Musik und Inszenierung verbinden. About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for a Delivery Director to lead customer delivery within the Customer Experience organization at Nebius.

Nebius provides cloud infrastructure for companies building and running AI/ML workloads. Your mission is to make customer deployments predictable: agree on realistic plans, keep teams aligned, and ensure customers are ready to go live.

You will lead the pre-sales and delivery TPM team and work closely with customers, Sales, Infrastructure, and Engineering. You will manage delivery commitments, address risks and delays, and help resolve difficult customer situations.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Coordinate customer delivery from contract signing to go-live, working with Infrastructure and Engineering on technical readiness.

  • Agree on timelines, delivery scope, and launch success criteria with customers and Sales.

  • Lead the pre-sales and delivery TPM team: set priorities, assign ownership, hire and develop people.

  • Align launch plans with Infrastructure and Engineering based on capacity and readiness.

  • Manage delivery risks and delays, including their impact on contracts, billing, and customer commitments.

  • Handle escalations and difficult discussions together with Sales and other leaders.

  • Ensure regular customer updates and a clear handover of commitments to post-sales teams.

  • Creation of deployment process documentation for customers.

  • Report on deliveries to GTM leadership, agree on priorities, and act on feedback.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience leading customer delivery in cloud, infrastructure, or other technical environments.

  • Experience working directly with senior customer stakeholders, managing expectations, delays, and escalations.

  • Experience leading TPMs or project managers, including hiring and team development.

  • Experience managing multiple deployments with shared resources and dependencies.

  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, and readiness for customer go-live.

  • Experience managing contractual delivery deadlines and their impact on billing and customer commitments.

  • Experience delivering international projects with distributed teams.

  • Fluent English.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • A background in professional services, consulting, or agency delivery.

  • Experience working with AI/ML infrastructure or GPU-based workloads.

 

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description: Design Engineer London, 5x days per week in-office Vega is looking for a Design Engineer to join our product design and engineering team. You will design and develop the interfaces and interactions for asset managers to work with Vega agents. The role suits someone who has worked as both a product designer and a (front-end) engineer. About Vega Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side. Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right. Who we are We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do. How we do it Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you: We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5. We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you. Who succeeds in this role We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further. In this role, you will: Design for people nobody has ever designed for. Operations teams at the world's largest asset managers run fragmented, inefficient processes on software built without care or context. Sit with them, watch them work, and turn what you see into flows that get the job done faster without weakening their controls. Take features through VegaOS from sketch to production. You design the flow, build it, and merge it into main alongside our engineers. Your spike is UI/UX but you don’t need full-time developers to build and ship your vision when push comes to shove. When something looks or feels wrong anywhere in the product, you confidently open the PRs yourself. Work in code from the first conversation with a PM so the team argues about something real, not a Figma frame. Design and build for AI in the loop. Much of VegaOS is screens where an agent has done part of the work and a human has to check it. Make that fast, legible and reversible. Own the design system: tokens, components, theming. Decide what goes in it, keep it consistent across the investor and asset manager portals, and make it easy for engineers to do the right thing by default. What we look for Real design experience and real shipping experience. Our rough guide is 4 years of product design and 2 years of production front-end, but evidence beats years: show us one thing you designed and built yourself that real users touch. Side projects and rough prototypes count but we are not looking for blind vibe prompting. Fluent in React, TypeScript and Tailwind, and you build with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor every day, with the judgement to review, test and own what they produce – code consistency, not just smooth UI/UX. You take a feature from a blank frame to a merged PR without someone else in the loop. You have designed and built dense, data-heavy B2B tools with AI in the workflow, and brought consumer-grade polish to enterprise-grade complexity. Strong opinions on design systems, held firmly enough to keep one coherent as a team ships fast around you, and loosely enough to change your mind when a PM, an engineer or a client is right. Bonus: experience in fintech, investing or another domain where being wrong is expensive. If you are someone who likes proactivity, ownership, intensity and being at the forefront of AI Design, this role is for you. Why join us? You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team Competitive salary and equity package Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm, working with the world’s leading companies to solve their most complex business challenges. We provide strategic counsel across communications, investor relations, financial transactions, restructuring, geopolitics, public affairs, management consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory and people advisory.

With more than 50 offices worldwide, Teneo partners with CEOs, boards and senior executives to help organisations earn trust, navigate disruption and deliver against their strategic objectives.

The Opportunity

Teneo is seeking a high-calibre Director to join our team in Berlin or Frankfurt. This is a senior, client-facing role with a focus on corporate communication and reputation.

Role Overview

As a Director in Teneo Strategy & Communications business in Europe, you will be responsible for building trusted senior client relationships, leading complex client mandates in collaboration with (Senior) Managing Director and contributing to the growth and reputation of the business.

Based in Berlin or Frankfurt, you will work closely with Teneo colleagues across Europe and the global network to deliver integrated advice to clients. This will include collaboration with specialists in corporate reputation, crisis preparedness and response, public affairs, geopolitics, management consulting, risk advisory, people advisory, sustainability, digital and creative campaigning.

This role requires both strategic advisory excellence and a strong commercial mindset. The successful candidate will be expected to bring market credibility, senior relationships, origination capability and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex, high-profile and often sensitive client situations.

Key Responsibilities

Client Counsel

o   Act as trusted adviser to clients across a diversity of sectors and industries.

o   Provide leadership on corporate narrative, reputation, stakeholder engagement, issues management and crisis preparedness.

o   Advise clients on how to communicate effectively with employees, media, government, regulators, customers, investors, partners and other key stakeholders.

o   Bring judgement, discretion and confidence to high-pressure situations involving complex stakeholder dynamics, significant public scrutiny and reputational risk.

Corporate Communications and Crisis Situations

o   Develop communications strategies around major corporate events, business transformation, leadership change, restructuring, litigation, regulatory scrutiny, operational incidents, cyber incidents, activism and other significant or sensitive situations.

o   Advise clients on crisis preparedness, scenario planning, crisis governance, response strategies, messaging and stakeholder engagement.

o   Work closely with legal advisers, public affairs teams, risk specialists, management consultants and other advisers to ensure communications strategies are aligned with broader business objectives and stakeholder considerations.

o   Provide leadership in fast-moving and high-pressure situations involving intense scrutiny, competing stakeholder expectations and significant reputational risk.

Media, Reputation and Stakeholder Management

o   Develop and execute media strategies involving German, European and international business, corporate and national media.

o   Advise clients on reputation management, corporate positioning, proactive storytelling, executive positioning, crisis situations and complex issues.

o   Help organisations build and protect trust with their most important stakeholders through clear, credible and consistent communications.

o   Provide senior counsel on emerging reputational risks, stakeholder expectations and issues that may affect corporate licence to operate.

Leadership

o   Leading project teams to develop and deliver communications that have real impact for our clients 

o   Providing team direction and management whilst acting as the day to day point of contact for clients

o   Challenging the status quo with new thinking, new product development, and new ways of working 

 

o   Responsible for leading client servicing, profitability, forecasting and budgeting 

o   Proactively contributing to and fostering the development of junior team members

 

Skills and Experience 

  • 8+ years’ experience of working in a senior role in corporate communications
  • Prior experience in an advisory firm is a plus
  • Demonstrable experience in managing project teams 
  • Excellent understanding of media, social media, and stakeholder environments
  • Excellent ability to shape and deliver strategic advice to senior level clients 
  • Able to manage and mentor junior staff 
  • An engaging self-starter with high attention to detail 
  • Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills 
  • A collaborator who is able to foster good working relationships 
  • Time management and the ability to prioritise a varied workload 
  • Comfortable taking the lead on driving performance and revenue 
  • Native level German required

 

About Teneo

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&I.

The firm has more than 2,000 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.

The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. About the Role

In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI-driven product execution, driving the end-to-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.

description: This is Cradle Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools. Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia. We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues. We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities. The Role As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care. Responsibilities Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email. Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled. Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side. Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks. Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards. Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves. Requirements The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you: 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec Clear, polished written English You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools Nice to Haves These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start: German fluency would be ideal to make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier Experience in a startup or scale-up environment Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations) Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear Our commitment to inclusive hiring Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. AI disclosure Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team. A notice about recruitment scams Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process. description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. We are focused on building the next generation of autonomous capabilities by leveraging existing Anduril platforms like Ghost or Altius, bringing 3rd party platforms into Anduril's Lattice ecosystem, and developing breakthrough systems that will shape the future of the battlefield. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this a fantastic opportunity.

Omen is Anduril's hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

This role is part of the new Omen flight test team in the UAE. The team runs Omen ground and flight testing in the UAE alongside our U.S. flight test team, using the same aircraft configuration, procedures and test plans, and works closely with our UAE partners.

About The Job

As a UAS Flight Test Engineer you will plan, execute and report on developmental and operational flight Test & Evaluation (T&E) activities. You will work alongside a team of engineers and test specialists assisting in the wider management and coordination of test and evaluation within the US, UK and Europein the UAE and the US under both civil and military approval schemes.

You will report to the Omen Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (SEIT) Lead in the UAE, work closely with the Omen SEIT Lead in the U.S., and support the Test Director during test activities.

You will be based in Abu Dhabi and travel regularly within the UAE, mainly to our remote test range (long days and early starts, with overnight stays when needed). Before flight testing starts in the UAE, you will spend an extended period in the United States (expected to be several months) training with the Omen flight test team at our Costa Mesa headquarters and U.S. test sites during the first prototype flight campaign. Expect further U.S. trips after that.

UAE nationals are encouraged to apply.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct rigorous testing and evaluation of Group 3 UAS to ensure performance and reliability.
  • Deploy to remote test sites within the US, with opportunity to support trials in overseas locations.Deploy to our remote test range in the UAE and to test sites within the US.
  • Participate in weekly stand-ups and provide progress reports to program and T&E leadership.
  • Develop and execute focused test plans for internal and customer trials.customer trials, traceable to the Omen Test and Evaluation Master Plan (TEMP).
  • Develop and implement baseline safety plans to mitigate risks during testing.
  • Communicate effectively within the team and across the organization.
  • Support the Test Director during UAE ground and flight tests: prepare test cards, monitor live data and record test points
  • Help the Test Director prepare UAE flight approval paperwork, including notifications to the UAE Military Airworthiness Authority, range bookings and radio frequency approvals
  • Collect, process and report flight test data, and share it with the U.S. team so both sites work from the same data and aircraft configuration
  • Support day-to-day coordination with our UAE partners and the range operator, including customer witnessing of key tests

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field.
  • 5-8+ years of experience in UAS integration, testing, and project management.
  • Ability and willingness to travel >75% time to remote locations in the US and overseasin the UAE and the US.
  • Understanding of the National Airspace System and UAS regulationsUAS regulations and airspace rules in the UAE (UAE Military Airworthiness Authority UAEMAR UAS, GCAA) and the US (National Airspace System).
  • Practical experience with large UAS testing and development.
  • Strong grasp of engineering principles and technical concepts.
  • Ability to organize, coordinate work effectively, and document thoroughly.
  • Familiarity with rotary-wing and fixed-wing aerodynamics and flight control systems.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently and in teams.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours as needed.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Ansprechperson, Coach und Rückhalt für dein Team aus 5 Teamleitenden und über 150 Lagermitarbeitenden. Du führst auf Augenhöhe, hörst zu, erkennst Potenziale und schaffst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich alle gesehen und wertgeschätzt fühlen.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du auch an trubeligen Tagen einen kühlen Kopf, priorisierst Aufgaben vorausschauend und hältst die Fäden im Tagesgeschäft sicher zusammen.
  • Abwechslung: Dich erwartet eine ausgewogene Mischung aus direktem Austausch auf dem FC Shopfloor (3–4 Tage pro Woche) und konzeptioneller Arbeit im FC Office (1–2 Tage pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Du schaust genau hin, wo es im Alltag hakt, holst dir Feedback von deinen Teamleitenden und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team praxistaugliche Lösungen, die unsere Abläufe Schritt für Schritt besser machen.
  • Verantwortung: Du denkst bereichsübergreifend mit, packst an, wo Unterstützung gebraucht wird, und arbeitest eng mit den anderen Operations Supervisors zusammen, um das FC gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.

Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, o.ä. ist willkommen. Dazu bringst du erste Erfahrung in der Logistik, im Lagerbetrieb oder in einem vergleichbaren operativen Umfeld mit.
  • Menschen stehen für dich an erster Stelle. Du bist empathisch, kommunikativ, fair und behältst auch in herausfordernden Gesprächen eine ruhige, lösungsorientierte Haltung.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst klare Entscheidungen und hast Freude daran, ein Team langfristig zu begleiten und stabil aufzubauen.
  • Du fühlst dich auf dem Shopfloor genauso wohl wie im Office, erkennst im Alltag schnell, wo Abläufe noch runder laufen können, und setzt pragmatische Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit deinem Team um.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und bist bereit, im 2-Schicht-System zu arbeiten (6:00–14:30 Uhr & 14:30–23:00 Uhr, inkl. samstags).

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Individuelle Mobilität: Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

description: Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures?
