You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action. About the role As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information. You will: support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities; own and maintain the data model analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights; investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers; build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis; use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use; investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting; help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working; contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes; translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights. An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights. Your development in data Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to: contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals; design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible; integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption); manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture; apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA; map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions; work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques; document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability. This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control. Collaboration & positioning You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective. Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe. The role is based at our head office in Almere. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights. You bring: willingness to learn around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller; solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics); experience with or a strong interest in Power BI; strong analytical skills; the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models; a curious and proactive approach to solving problems; the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working; an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve; a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data; fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable. experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What we offer This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used. You can expect: a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience. an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; a pension scheme; a commuting allowance; a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued; the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop; structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role; a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks. We are HG HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products. We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems. HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance. We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact. HG does what it promises. Do you have any questions? As a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility, go-e GmbH is making the transition from start-up to an internationally recognized player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, we have already expanded to around 20 countries in Europe. With bold ideas around our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies. The go-e employees contribute with their personality to the good working atmosphere, and their individuality is a foundation for our common success.

description: Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. The assets themselves already work brilliantly, but getting them into homes is still slow, complex and painful. Our mission is to change that: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run a renewables installation business, and get homes off fossil fuels way faster. In just a few years we've become the leading platform for heat pump installers in the UK and Ireland, with around half of all heat pump installations now being managed on Spruce. We've just launched our solar and battery product, and we're building on that to go after even bigger opportunities: every other type of job these installers do, the rest of how they run their business, and a bunch of new countries. We're now on the hunt for a truly brilliant designer who wants to grow a company. You'll design everything that sells Spruce: the website, ads, launches and sales materials, and you'll own our visual brand. 🌲 About Spruce Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates. We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have doubled the team and grown revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, have just launched an end-to-end solar and battery product, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed… 🥖 The Role We want someone who cares deeply about visual craft and just as much about whether the work sells. We're launching new features and entering new markets, so how we explain and sell Spruce will keep changing - you'll be the designer working that out with our growth and sales teams. Day-to-day you'll be: Owning spruce.eco – You'll own our website: its design, the story it tells, and the landing pages for each new market and product. You'll keep testing and changing it, so it sells Spruce as well as our best demo does. Telling the product's story – You'll take a product that does genuinely hard things (building physics, fluid dynamics, LiDAR!) and, with every launch, turn it into a story a busy installation business owner gets in five seconds. You'll tell it through launch assets, sales decks, case studies and one-pagers for trade shows. Making ads and campaigns that earn their keep – You'll make static and motion creative for our paid campaigns, and work with the Growth team to test what converts and do more of it. Owning the brand – You'll own Spruce's visual identity as we grow into new products and new kinds of customer, and build the system (guidelines, components, templates) that keeps it coherent and lets the rest of the team self-serve. Covering events, print & the long tail – You'll design event stands, and email, and onboarding and support materials that make installers feel looked after – plus the templates and motion graphics that keep our video and social output looking unmistakably Spruce. If you'd like to influence how the product itself looks, there's room for that too. There's budget for freelancers on specialist work, but we're looking for a real do-er: someone who makes most things themselves, fast, and loves doing it. 🫵 About You We look for the same five things in everyone at Spruce: curiosity; intense drive, ambition and work ethic; a high degree of personal agency and ownership; deep humility and a growth mindset; and excellent craft. For this role we're looking for a designer with 3+ years of marketing and brand design experience (and potentially a lot more), who has built websites, campaigns and brands many times over and knows what worked. We'd love to speak with you if this sounds like you: Visual craft and range – typography, layout, colour, with a portfolio that shows real taste. You're strong across web, campaign and brand design, with working proficiency in motion; Commercially minded – you want your work to move the numbers: new customers won, and existing customers doing more with Spruce. description: Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions. It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable. Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket. We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly. ⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️ We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew: Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process. Why is this role interesting? Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption What will you do with us? You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model. Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities: Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns Then, depending on your crew: Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales. Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams. By your first year, we'll know it worked when: At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion ⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️ You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you: Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C) Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent) Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment Communicate with excellent written and spoken English Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona. All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport. Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture. Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles. After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply! Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info. description: About us: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. About the role: We’re looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and scale the operational engine behind DeepJudge’s marketing and qualified pipeline growth. This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the lifecycle, scoring, routing, campaign and attribution systems. You’ll act as a strategic and operational business partner to Content, Field, Demand Gen and Product Marketing, and work with Sales, RevOps and Partnerships to make sure every lead and target account reaches the right seller, and that we know which programs created the pipeline. If you naturally think: “Which campaign actually created this opportunity, and why did it take three days to reach a rep?” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. You will play a key role in giving our growing sales team a reliable flow of qualified pipeline and in driving commercial success. Your responsibilities will include: Lead and account lifecycle Own the lead and account lifecycle from first touch to sales-qualified opportunity, including lifecycle stages, MQL/SQL definitions and SLAs Design and maintain lead scoring, inbound routing and assignment rules as the marketing and sales team grows Run the Marketing-to-Sales handoff with clear acceptance criteria and feedback loops Campaign, event and partner marketing operations Administer HubSpot Marketing Hub and its integrations with ad, event and enrichment tools Operationalize field and growth marketing: event lead capture, ABM programs, nurture workflows and partner campaigns Own campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting AI, automation, and marketing innovation Identify, test and roll out AI tools and automations that measurably improve marketing performance, scalability and efficiency. Build workflows connecting intent signals, enrichment, CRM, landing pages and advertising platforms, to power ABM and personalized campaigns at scale, in partnership with Demand Generation. Turn successful experiments into repeatable processes, partnering with our GTM Engineer on complex integrations and shared technical infrastructure. Partner with Demand Generation to scale campaigns through AI-assisted segmentation, dynamic landing pages and targeted advertising. Experiment with emerging GTM technologies and turn successful prototypes into repeatable marketing processes. Attribution and performance Own campaigns and marketing attribution frameworks and pipeline source reporting. Build and maintain marketing funnel dashboard, in terms of volume, stage conversion, velocity and campaign ROI. Analyze marketing funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness. Data quality and business partnership Set and enforce marketing data standards: hygiene, enrichment, deduplication and consent management Act as Operational business partner to Marketing, Sales and CSM, Partnership leadership What success looks like in 12 months: Every inbound lead and target account reaches the right owner within an agreed SLA Marketing and Sales work from one shared set of lifecycle definitions and with a trusted MQL/SQL handoff Field and Demand Gen spend measurably less time on admin because they can rely on an efficient system from lead to SQL Leadership can see which campaigns, events and partners touched and created pipeline Marketing data completeness and accuracy support leadership decision making AI-powered workflows run in production across ABM and lifecycle marketing, with measurable gains in efficiency or performance You're a great fit if you: Have 4+ years in Marketing Operations or Demand Generation Operations in B2B SaaS, including time at a high-growth company Have deep hands-on expertise in HubSpot Marketing Hub administration (Marketo or Pardot also considered) Have a proven track record designing lead lifecycle, scoring and routing for a sales team that scaled Have experience building campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting Have hands-on experience building automations and enrichment workflows (e.g. Clay, Zapier/n8n, ZoomInfo/Apollo, intent data) Bring an analytical mindset with comfort in funnel math and data quality work Have excellent stakeholder management across GTM teams What you can look forward to: Owning the marketing operations engine that supports marketing and feeds a growing sales team Helping shape how a category-defining AI company builds and scales its go-to-market engine from the ground up description: Wij zoeken voor onze afdeling marketing en communicatie een enthousiaste en pro actieve stagiaire die zich gaat focussen op ondersteuning van campagnes en creëren van content. Lijkt je dit iets? Solliciteer dan nu! Let op: de stageperiode waarvoor wij zoeken is die van februari 2027 tot juni 2027 voor een periode van 15 tot 24 weken. Jouw rol Bij Heras bieden we je een leerzame en uitdagende stageplaats waarbij je volop kansen krijgt om waardevolle ervaringen op te doen die in het verdere verloop van je carrière nuttig zijn. Je gaat gecombineerd stage lopen op de afdeling Marketing en de afdeling Brand & Communications voor de Benelux. Je krijgt in ons mooie en dynamische bedrijf de kans om actief aan de slag te gaan met verschillende activiteiten en projecten. Uiteraard word je goed begeleid door de Marketing Manager en de Manager Brand & Commmunications. Vooraf zal je (stage)opdracht in overleg met jou en school worden opgesteld. Het onderwerp is mede afhankelijk van de projecten die lopen en jouw persoonlijke interesses. Bedenken, coördineren en schrijven van artikelen, blogs, nieuwsitems, customer cases Schrijven en inplannen van alle social media Ondersteunen interne communicatie en bijbehorende platformen Content management op diverse platformen, zoals onze websites Meedenken en meewerken aan marketingcampagnes, en daarvoor online content creëren Teksten schrijven voor e-mailcampagnes en nieuwsbrieven Ondersteuning van de marketing manager bij diverse projecten Bijdragen aan verschillende evenementen zoals bijvoorbeeld een stagemarkt Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland Jouw profiel Je volgt momenteel een HBO- of MBO-studie Communicatie, Marketing of Journalistiek en zoekt een meewerkstage 2e, 3e of 4e jaars. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift Je bent creatief, werkt gestructureerd en bent in staat om het overzicht te behouden Het tonen van eigen initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd Flinke mate van zelfstandigheid Je beschikt over goede sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden Wat bieden wij jou? Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Je creëert jouw eigen toekomst bij Heras. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. description: Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks. The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams. The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners. The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel. Here is how your key outcomes will look like: Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes. ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem. The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build. You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are: 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus. We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level. Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport. Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture. Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles. After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply! Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info. An overview of this role

As a Demo Architect, you'll help GitLab teams and customers get hands-on with our platform faster and with less friction. This role reports to the Senior Director of our Solutions Architecture Center of Excellence, with day-to-day partnership from the current team lead. You'll build and improve the tools, applications, and infrastructure that support field team demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments across the field. 

What makes this role unique is its mix of software engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing collaboration. You'll work like an engineer for much of the role, while also partnering with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, and others to make sure what we build is practical, usable, and aligned to how the field sells.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain tools, applications, and workflows that support demos, workshops, trials, and internal test environments.
  • Expand the Demo Architect Portal to improve automation, self-service, and scalability for field teams and partners.
  • Provision and support infrastructure that enables hands-on customer experiences across GitLab.com, demo instances, and internal environments.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Architects, Account Executives, Customer Success, Marketing, Revenue Operations, UX, and Engineering to understand needs and deliver practical technical solutions.
  • Learn and document go-to-market workflows (e.g., how teams run demos/workshops/trials) and automate the steps that waste time.
  • Create technical workshop assets and enablement content that support pre-sales and technical selling for individual contributors.
  • Advise on sales opportunities when specialized technical demo support or custom solutions are needed.
  • Improve the presenter experience by reducing manual setup work and making demo workflows easier to use and repeat.
  • Support internal teams that rely on demo or test infrastructure, helping keep those environments available and useful.
  • Troubleshoot urgent demo/workshop environment issues under pressure and communicate status clearly to stakeholders.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building software, systems, or internal tools that support technical users or business teams.
  • Ability to deliver production-grade software and automation with attention to reliability, maintainability, and documentation.
  • Ability to work across application development and infrastructure, with comfort navigating provisioning, automation, and service workflows.
  • Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools to shorten investigation time when something breaks.
  • Comfort communicating and collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Marketing, UX, and Engineering.
  • Understanding of how to design and iterate on solutions for usability and repeatability, not just technical correctness, with awareness that the end user may be a seller or Solutions Architect.
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, asynchronous environment, with willingness to travel periodically for team offsites and occasional in-person planning/whiteboarding sessions.
  • Exposure to technical demos, workshops, trials, or enablement assets, and/or interest in learning the pre-sales context; transferable experience from software engineering, site reliability engineering, systems engineering, solutions architecture, or similar technical paths.   #LI-CM1

About the team

On the Demo Architect team at GitLab, we support the field’s demo, workshop, and trial experiences by maintaining shared tooling and the infrastructure behind internal demo and test instances used across GitLab. We’re a small, globally distributed group that collaborates asynchronously across regions and adapts quickly to changing needs, with a current focus on scaling automation, enabling more self-service, extending support to partners, and maintaining reliable internal infrastructure.

description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

About the role

Special objects are the final frontier of e-commerce. As Senior Category Lead for Art – Primary Market, you’ll bring structure and consistency to the team’s day-to-day work. You’ll turn priorities into clear plans, strengthen how work moves across the team, and help each person take ownership of outcomes. Alongside this operational focus, you’ll support the Senior Category Manager in translating the category vision into practical initiatives that improve the experience for buyers and sellers.

You’ll create an engaged team culture built on trust, clear expectations, and accountability, helping people build on their strengths and grow in their roles.

You’ll also coordinate with Sales, Marketing, and other relevant teams to deliver cross-functional improvements and keep the category’s priorities moving.

What you’ll do

  • Create a clear operating rhythm: Turn category priorities into practical plans with clear owners, milestones, and regular follow-up so work moves forward reliably.
  • Improve day-to-day operations: Clarify workflows and handovers, spot bottlenecks early, and help the team resolve blockers.
  • Build team ownership and accountability: Set clear goals and expectations, coach team members to take responsibility for their work, and help them use their strengths.
  • Strengthen engagement and development: Hold regular 1:1s, give timely feedback, and support each person’s growth in partnership with the Senior Category Manager.
  • Use performance insights to guide action: Monitor category results, identify risks and opportunities, and coordinate focused actions with relevant teams.
  • Translate strategy into delivery: Support the Senior Category Manager’s vision by coordinating cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution and review.
  • Identify category growth opportunities: Use market and performance insight to spot where the category can grow, then work with relevant teams to turn promising opportunities into practical initiatives.

What you’ll bring

  • Operational leadership: You have a strong track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and ensuring reliable execution in a category, sales, or commercial team.
  • Team leadership and coaching: You help colleagues perform at their best through clear goals, regular feedback, coaching, and support.
  • Ownership and accountability: You set clear expectations, follow through on commitments, and encourage others to take responsibility for outcomes.
  • Organised project delivery: You coordinate cross-functional work, manage dependencies and timelines, and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • Analytical judgment: You use data and customer or market insight to identify issues, set priorities, and evaluate results.
  • Clear, constructive communication: You build trust, share context, give direct feedback, and adapt your communication to different stakeholders.
  • Interest in contemporary art: You bring a genuine interest in contemporary art and the primary art market.

How we work in the Art Team

  • We’re a supportive, friendly Art team that works together to tackle ambitious growth challenges.
  • You’ll work across Art – Primary Market, supporting the Direct from the Artist and Photography categories with clear day-to-day priorities and coordinated delivery.
  • You’ll collaborate with Sales, Marketing, HR, and relevant partner teams, agreeing owners and next steps so decisions turn into action.
  • You’ll report to the Senior Category Manager in Art – Primary Market and take part in the Art cluster’s management discussions, sharing updates, aligning on priorities, and raising blockers early.

Where you'll be

Preferably this role is hybrid,  based in Amsterdam. You’ll work from our Amsterdam HQ at least two days per week.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Category Manager, Bedding - UK/EU

We are seeking a regional Senior Category Manager, Bedding UK/EU to join our growing team reporting into the Head of Home UK/EU. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. It leads the execution of merchandising strategy across the Bedding category, with responsibility for driving regional performance through strong product execution, trading, and customer insight. In this role, you will play a key part in scaling Quince’s value proposition in international markets by delivering a compelling regional assortment, optimizing the customer experience, and partnering cross-functionally to bring high-quality products to market.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end merchandising for the Bedding category across UK/EU including assortment execution, launches, and performance tracking
  • Execute regional merchandising strategy in partnership with US Product Merchandising and international regional merchandising peers
  • Contribute to product ideation, helping shape new product opportunities and business cases
  • Work cross-functionally with Product and Regional Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Technical Design, and Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)
  • Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) and take ownership of actions to improve results
  • Support pricing and assortment decisions for the region
  • Own product catalogue management and administration, including product setup, data accuracy, and system maintenance
  • Build site merchandising strategy, including PDP improvements roadmap and customer journey optimisations
  • Monitor ratings, reviews, and returns to identify and support product quality improvements
  • Manage regional product samples and merchandising assets
  • Maintain merchandising reports, tools, trackers, and pricing files
  • Take ownership of evaluating regional product compliance requirements and partner with Sourcing and Quality teams to execute

Qualifications required: 

  • Role is based in London / Madrid or Berlin with 4 days per week in-office requirement
  • 8-10 years of retail buying or category experience in Home Textiles / Bedding, with demonstrated ownership of category performance
  • E-commerce and/or DTC experience, with exposure to both startup and established (blue-chip) brands preferred
  • Proven track record of progressing within an organisation and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferred
  • Strong product awareness, with a commercial mindset and attention to detail
  • Product obsessed, with experience leveraging data tools and external sources to drive results
  • Critical eye to anticipate customer needs (both the “science” and “art” of retail merchandising)
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to inform trading and merchandising decisions (e.g. sales, margin, return rates)
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both executional and strategic support roles
  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Planning, Design, Sourcing, or Marketing
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with particular ability to influence through concise written narrative
  • Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
  • Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity and change.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Product Support Engineering exists to maximise the operational availability of the Dive-XL fleet. We sit between the teams in the field who operate and sustain the system alongside our customers, and the engineering teams that design it. When something unexpected happens — at sea, at a maintenance facility, in the middle of the night — we are the engineering team that answers, works out what happened, and decides how to proceed. The other part of the job is making sure it does not happen twice. We drive reliability and supportability improvements into the system, and keep the fleet's configuration and documentation current as it evolves. Between us we cover every engineering discipline — software, electrical, mechanical, systems.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for Senior Product Support Engineers to join the Dive-XL team, supporting the teams operating and maintaining Anduril's Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicles. You will be will support the operational fleet on a rotating roster that extends out-of-hours, providing anything from immediate technical guidance to formal root cause analysis. Each request means assessing severity, scoping the work and doing the investigation. From there you'll direct the engineering change, maintenance activity, workaround or documentation fix that resolves it, and own its rollout across every affected vehicle. You will also work to reduce support demand through sparing strategy, reliability and supportability improvements, better diagnostics and tooling, and supportability requirements fed into new variants during design. You will need genuine depth in an engineering discipline, enough breadth to triage across the others, and the judgement to make a call on limited data.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide on-call engineering support to the teams operating and maintaining fielded AUVs, including outside business hours on a rotating roster
  • Establish what happened from logs, telemetry, configuration and maintenance history, bound the issue to a subsystem and failure mode and define workarounds that restore capability
  • Plan and lead root cause investigations to a defensible conclusion — systemic or isolated, and whether design, production, maintenance or operation induced
  • Chair Material Review Board dispositions and manage fleet-wide system limitations, including whether to operate in a degraded state
  • Turn fleet data into engineering recommendations and requirements, and drive those changes through the design teams
  • Build the monitoring, alerting and diagnostic tooling that surfaces problems before the field reports them, and the run books and knowledge base that shorten every response
  • Author and distribute service bulletins, and track incorporation across the fleet to completion
  • Create or approve operations, troubleshooting, incident response and maintenance publications
  • Govern the as-maintained configuration and SBOM

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A genuine interest and 5+ years of professional experience in software, electrical, mechanical, mechatronic or systems engineering on complex systems
  • Demonstrated ability to independently root cause difficult, ambiguous faults from limited or conflicting data
  • Hands-on experience with real hardware in an operational, field, integration and test, production or maintenance environment
  • Sound engineering judgement under time pressure, including assessing the acceptability of degraded operation
  • Strong coordination and communication, able to own an issue, manage stakeholders and drive it to resolution or a clean handover, and to explain a technical finding to engineers and non-engineers
  • Experience with configuration management, engineering change processes, and fleet-wide change incorporation
  • Experience with robotic and/or autonomous systems within the maritime environment is advantageous
  • A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a NV2 Security Clearance

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Als Senior Project Manager Creative ben jij de spil tussen klant, jouw eigen creatie team en mediaspecialisten. Voor jouw klanten ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt: je denkt mee, geeft advies en zorgt dat ideeën werkelijkheid worden.

Wat ga je concreet doen?

  • Je organiseert en bewaakt het projectplan van A tot Z, inclusief scope, deadlines en deliverables.
  • Je zorgt voor heldere projectstructuren en planning voor alle disciplines.
  • Je bent hét centrale aanspreekpunt voor klanten, interne teams en externe partners.
  • Je vertaalt creatieve en commerciële briefing naar uitvoerbare plannen en bewaakt verwachtingen.
  • Je identificeert risico’s vroegtijdig en zorgt dat issues worden opgelost voordat ze impact hebben.
  • Je bewaakt scopes, kwaliteitscriteria en KPI’s, en rapporteert hierover.
  • Je draagt bij aan verbeterde workflows, tools en werkwijzen zodat het team nog efficiënter werkt.
  • Je fungeert als brug tussen creatie, media en operations.

Wie ben jij?

  • Sterke projectmanager met min. 5+ jaar ervaring in rollen die draaien om planning, coördinatie, organisatie en procesoptimalisatie.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het managen van complexe projecten (in agencies, techteams, productteams of andere uitvoerende omgevingen).
  • Je bent een pro in overzicht houden, risico’s inschatten en structureel werken — en je weet dit zelfverzekerd te vertalen naar teams en klanten.
  • Je hebt geen creatieve productie-achtergrond nodig (zoals design of copywriting); wat telt is jouw vermogen om projecten tot een goed einde te brengen.
  • Voorkeur voor ervaring met middelenbegrotingen, resource-planning en KPI-gestuurde workflows.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Salaris: €3000 – 4250 bruto per maand (op basis van 38,75 uur per week) afhankelijk van ervaring, leeftijd en senioriteit.
  • Flexibiliteit: Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).
  • Vrijheid: Veel eigen verantwoordelijk om je eigen rol en werkdag in te vullen.
  • Werkomgeving: werken in een goed georganiseerde creatieve omgeving met een enthousiast team van creatieven, projectmanagers en mediaspecialisten.
  • Klanten: Werken voor A merken van Nederland en internationaal op projecten waar je écht trots op kunt zijn en die zichtbaar impact maken.
  • Groeikansen: Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team, met een focus op AI-transformatie.
  • Toegang tot M Academy: Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding: Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.
  • 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).
  • Hybrid Working allowance: €30 netto per maand bij fulltime.
  • Bring Your Own Device (BYOD): Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van €57,50 netto.
  • Lunchfaciliteiten: Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.
  • Zorgverzekering: Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering.

Geen dag is hier hetzelfde! Het ene moment duik je in een briefing met een klant, het volgende moment ben je met een creative bezig om een campagne pixel-perfect te krijgen. Je werkt met verschillende disciplines, klanten en uitdagingen, waardoor je continu leert en groeit. En jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat alles klopt.

description:
Complexe projecten, volop mogelijkheden om te groeien en werken bij één van de top Microsoft system integrators van Nederland. Als Senior Project manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van Microsoft technologie en geef je leiding aan het projectteam van HSO.  

We bouwen steeds vaker oplossingen voor klanten die niet alleen ERP willen, maar die bewust kiezen voor het Microsoft Cloud platform. En dus bijvoorbeeld ook kiezen voor Dynamics 365 for CRM, Field Service en Power BI. Omdat HSO één van de weinige Microsoft system integrators is, kunnen we klanten deze totaaloplossing bieden. De complexe en grotere internationale projecten vragen veel expertise en ervaring, Dus we hebben volop werk en uitdaging! 

Ben jij gewend om grootschalige Microsoft applicatie projecten te leiden? 

Wat ga je doen? 

Als Senior Project manager schakel je continu tussen de belangen van de klant en HSO. De projecten zijn bovengemiddeld complex van aard en de stakeholders zijn vaak over meerdere bedrijven en de wereld verspreid. Dit is geen uitdaging maar gesneden koek voor jou. 

 

Jij beschikt over: 

  • Ten minste 5 jaar ervaring met ERP-implementaties als Project manager;
  • Je deelt onze mind set: je bent een kritische denker, een ondernemende zelf starter en je verbindt je met het resultaat;
  • Je business English is dik in orde, gezien onze internationale projecten;
  • Je management vaardigheden zijn consulterend, anticiperend en voorstellend van aard en gebruikt deze eigenschappen om mensen met je mee te krijgen en effectief te laten functioneren;
  • Ervaring met het Microsoft-platform, Dynamics AX 2012 of Dynamics 365 is een pre;
  • Aantoonbare kennis van methodieken voor project management zowel waterval als Agile, bijvoorbeeld PRINCE II, PMI- of IPMA C/D-certificering.

Wat bieden we jou?  

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:  

  • Een competitief salaris en een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties 
  • Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daarbovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;
  • EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun  

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden. 

Over HSO  

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  
 

HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

description: ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”. In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”. 85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr. Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein. Technology never rests. Neither do we. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Als “Senior Recruiter” im Team Recruiting von freiheit.com sind dies Deine Verantwortungsbereiche: Active Sourcing auf Top-Niveau: Du verlässt dich nicht auf eingehende Bewerbungen, sondern spürst per Active Sourcing die besten Talente auf. Du findest genau die Menschen, die das Mindset, den Willen und die Disziplin mitbringen, um mit uns „Mission Impossible“-Projekte Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen. Klasse statt Masse: Dein Ziel ist es nicht, Bewerberzahlen künstlich aufzublähen, sondern von vornherein die richtigen Leute über die passenden Kanäle anzusprechen. Du steuerst deine Sourcing-Pipelines datengetrieben, misst Response- sowie Conversion-Rates und optimierst jeden Schritt für ein stetiges, nachhaltiges Wachstum unserer Community. Engineers recruit Engineers: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Engineering-Teams und dem Management zusammen. Dabei hast du die Koordination des Bewerbermanagements fest im Griff, schaffst klare Strukturen und sicherst die Prozessqualität durch dokumentierte Standards. Volle Ownership & KPI-Transparenz: Du sprichst die Sprache deiner Stakeholder und übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für eure Recruiting-Ergebnisse. Zu jedem Zeitpunkt kannst du alle Fragen zu deinen Pipelines, Sourcing-Erfolgen und KPIs präzise beantworten. Langfristige Netzwerke aufbauen: Mit deiner offenen, direkten Art knüpfst und pflegst du nachhaltige Verbindungen zu Universitäten, Studentengruppen und spezialisierten Partnern, um unseren Talent-Pool kontinuierlich zu stärken. High-Speed als Normalzustand: Ein hochdynamisches, schnelllebiges Umfeld spornt dich an. Du bist ehrgeizig, willst selbst jeden Tag besser werden und suchst ständig nach der nächsten Herausforderung. ÜBER DICH Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting– idealerweise in einem technologie- oder softwaregetriebenen Umfeld. Du bist ein Profi im Active Sourcing: Du beherrschst moderne Suchstrategien, schreibst individuelle Nachrichten mit hoher Antwortquote und weißt, wie man passive Top-Talente überzeugt. Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium bevorzugt in (Sport) Psychologie oder in der Fachrichtung Personalwesen, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. Du hast Spaß daran, selbständig zu arbeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und an neuen Herausforderungen zu wachsen. Du bist gut im Networking und hast Freude daran, dauerhafte Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen. Du hast Durchhaltevermögen und “Situational Awareness” mit absolutem Willen zum Erfolg. Du bist offen, empathisch, klar in der Kommunikation und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit einem starken Team etwas zu bewegen. Du bist mitreißend, charmant und selbstbewusst. Du suchst nicht einfach nur irgendeinen Job: Du möchtest lernen und deine Ideen und Fähigkeiten einsetzen, um einen bleibenden Beitrag für unsere Community zu leisten. ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“. Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind. In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, mit intelligenten Menschen an spannenden Aufgaben zu arbeiten und Projekte von der Idee bis zur Auslieferung umzusetzen – end-to-end. Ein wahrer Experte in seinem Fachgebiet wird man nicht über Nacht – dazu braucht es Jahre harter Arbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen. Als ein Member unserer Community wird viel von dir verlangt, und niemand kann die Arbeit für dich übernehmen. Unser Unternehmen ist ein Ort, an dem du die beste Version deiner selbst werden kannst. ***Wir bieten keine reinen Remote-Stellen an. Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche im Büro. DAZUGEHÖREN? Dann schicke uns Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) über unser Bewerberportal.
