description: Ontotext, doing business as Graphwise, is looking for Senior Java Backend Engineer. We need your expertise to help us build great knowledge graph products. Knowledge graphs help enterprises ground AI algorithms, reduce hallucinations and represent complex domain models. If you are a skilled backend engineer capable of understanding complex problems, enjoy architecting efficient designs and want to tackle technical challenges, please consider this job opportunity in the Product & Technology division. About Graphwise: Graphwise enables organizations to unlock ROI for enterprise AI by delivering the most comprehensive and trusted industry solutions in the field of knowledge graphs and semantic AI technologies. Graphwise delivers the critical knowledge graph infrastructure to ensure enterprises are ready to realize the technology’s full potential. Graphwise, which is the result of the merger between tech visionaries Ontotext and Semantic Web Company, has over 200 employees worldwide, with offices located across North America, Europe, and APAC. Our main development offices are in Sofia, Vienna and Ruse If you are interested in technology and working in a close-knit, dynamic environment, Graphwise might be the right fit for you! About the Role: At Graphwise we work in hybrid mode from our offices in Sofia, Vienna and Ruse. . You will be expected to spend at least 8 days monthly in one of our offices. Our teams are distributed in squads between 5 and 10 engineers. We do believe that to build a brilliant team, people should meet, collaborate, exchange ideas and maintain healthy human relationships As Senior Backend Engineer you will be expected to: Design, implement and test new features in the GraphDB backend Review the code of your peers and output high-quality code Improve the database performance by optimizing its concurrency and researching novel algorithms Debug the database code and chase complex to reproduce issues under concurrent transactional load To filter applicants who do not read job descriptions, please submit, in your application form a valid JSON-LD string in the Address field (check https://json-ld.org/playground/) with your name and a link to your LinkedIn profile Your Profile: 4+ years of experience in Java or another strongly typed programming language (Rust, CPP, Go etc.) Strong engineering culture, analytical skills and proficiency in multithreading & algorithmic analysis Deep technical experience in database internals, structures and graphs Experience with knowledge representation, database modeling or logic programming is a big plus A degree in Computer Science, Information Technologies, or a related field Experience building and maintaining distributed systems Knowledge of gRPC or similar RPC frameworks Experience with performance and memory profiling using tools such as Java Flight Recorder (JFR), flame graphs, or similar profiling tools Familiarity with JVM internals and advanced performance tuning Hiring process: Graphwise is a fully transparent company. The hiring process has the following steps: Applications will be filtered based on the required skills Phone / Google Meet screening interview by the HR department Onsite / Online technical interview Onsite final meeting with a job interview What We Offer: A friendly and professional international team and working environment in a rapidly-expanding tech and AI company Exposure to the newest technologies in AI and knowledge graphs space A workplace in an organization that is committed to sustainability and responsible business practices An international workspace where more than 65% of colleagues come from across the globe. English is the main working language at the company Flexible working hours and benefits that reflect our belief that a healthy work-life balance is a key driver of efficiency Career development path, through: paid internal & external trainings on an individual and team level; hands-on experience; time for innovation, and many more And, of course, we offer free tea, coffee, fruit, and snacks Graphwise welcomes applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender expression, age, disability, and other statuses. Our company culture as well as policies enforced by our active Diversity Equity & Inclusion Group work towards ensuring we have an inclusive workplace.

description: We are looking for a Presales Engineer to join our passionate international team. At Graphwise, you’ll work alongside great people with a wide variety of backgrounds and talents who share a passion for knowledge management and AI technologies. If you are interested in AI technology and innovation then Graphwise is the right fit for you! About Graphwise: Graphwise enables organizations to realize the full value of enterprise AI by delivering the most comprehensive and trusted industry solutions in the field of knowledge graphs and semantic AI technologies. Graphwise delivers the critical knowledge graph infrastructure to ensure enterprises are ready to realize the technology’s full potential. Graphwise, which is the result of the merger between tech visionaries Ontotext and the Semantic Web Company, has over 200 employees worldwide and offices located across North America, Europe and APAC. About the Role: As Presales Engineer, you will work with prospective customers and partners to understand their technical and business challenges, design solution architectures using Graphwise technologies, and demonstrate how our platform can deliver measurable value. You will guide customers through the technical evaluation process, from discovery and solution design to proof-of-concepts and implementation planning. Your goal will be to help our partners and customers increase their top-line revenue while ensuring successful adoption of Graphwise technology. You will partner closely with Sales, Partner, Services, and Marketing teams to provide technical expertise throughout the sales process. Your Main Responsibilities shall include: ● Lead the technical engagement during the sales cycle, including discovery, solution design, and technical validation. ● Conduct technical discovery sessions to understand customer business objectives, data challenges, and integration requirements. ● Translate customer needs into solution architectures using Graphwise technologies such as knowledge graphs and semantic AI. ● Deliver product demonstrations, technical presentations, proof-of-value, and proof-of-concept design and planning ● Collaborate with Direct Sales, Partner Sales, Marketing, Product, and Solution teams to develop winning solutions ● Support technical onboarding and deployment planning for new customers and partners. ● Serve as a trusted technical advisor to prospects and customers throughout the sales process. ● Continuously learn and stay current on Graphwise technologies, AI trends, and the evolving data ecosystem. ● Contribute feedback from the field to help improve product capabilities and sales strategies. As the Ideal Candidate, You Will Have: ● Understanding or interest in semantic web technologies, knowledge graphs, graph databases, text mining, ontology engineering, machine learning, or related fields. ● Experience supporting technical sales processes, solution engineering, or at customer-facing technical roles. ● Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for customers. ● Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, with the ability to interpret technical and market data. ● Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus. ● Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional teams. ● And, of course, we offer free tea, coffee, fruit, and snacks What We Offer: ● A friendly and professional international team and working environment in a rapidly-expanding tech and AI company ● Exposure to the newest technologies in AI and knowledge graphs space ● A workplace in an organization that is committed to sustainability and responsible business practices ● An international workspace where more than 65% of colleagues come from across the globe. English is the main working language at the company ● Flexible working hours and benefits that reflect our belief that a healthy work-life balance is a key driver of efficiency ● Career development path, through: paid internal & external trainings on an individual and team level; hands-on experience and many more ● And, of course, we offer free tea, coffee, fruit, and snacks Graphwise welcomes applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender expression, age, disability, and other statuses. Our company culture as well as policies enforced by our active Diversity Equity & Inclusion Group work towards ensuring we have an inclusive workplace.

title: Presales Engineer

description: At Graphwise, we help enterprises transform fragmented data into connected, intelligent systems using Knowledge Graphs, semantic technologies, and modern AI architectures. About the role We’re looking for a strong Software Engineer with experience in data engineering and an interest in AI systems, data modeling, and large-scale information architectures. title: Data Engineer for AI

description: We are looking for a Knowledge Graph Solutions Consultant to join our passionate international team. As part of our organization you will work alongside great people with a wide variety of backgrounds and talents who share a passion for knowledge graphs and AI technologies, delivering solutions created on top of the globally renowned product Graphwise AI Platform to customers. About Graphwise Graphwise enables organizations to realize the full value of enterprise AI by delivering the most comprehensive and trusted industry solutions in the field of knowledge graphs and semantic AI technologies. We deliver the critical knowledge graph infrastructure to ensure enterprises are ready to realize the technology’s full potential. Graphwise, formed by the merger of two tech visionaries: Ontotext and Semantic Web Company, has over 200 employees worldwide and offices located across North America, Europe and the Asia-Pacific region. The working language at the company is English. If you are interested in knowledge organization, AI technology and innovation, Graphwise is the right fit for you! About the Professional Services Department As a solutions consultant you will be part of the Professional Services department with team members distributed across Austria, Bulgaria, UK, France and Greece, with technical and non-technical backgrounds ranging from knowledge management, project management and computational linguistics to data engineering, software engineering or system engineering. The Professional Services department works closely with our clients and prospective clients to design and build solutions on top of Graphwise product portfolio based on their business and technology requirements, to deliver state of the art functionality and business value to our clients. About the Role The Solutions Consultant holds the subject matter expertise in Graphwise products, the knowledge graph based businesses and use cases, works with customers to advise, design and develop comprehensive solutions based on Graphwise product portfolio and the related technology ecosystem which fulfill customers business and technology requirements. The solutions consultant provides operational guidance in the solution development process, developing technical solution proposals and driving the implementation to ensure the developed solutions align with customers’ longer term objectives, existing IT landscape, and other organizational constraints. The solutions consultant facilitates the delivery of Graphwise products and the realization of their values, which eventually contributes to customers’ success and development of growth opportunities. The Solutions Consultant will work from our offices in Vienna, Austria or in Sofia, Bulgaria (partly remote work, up to 3 days a week, is available after the initial onboarding period). For senior candidates, fully remote work is also possible. Key Responsibilities Customer and Business Engagement Use case modeling and requirements engineering: work directly with customers to understand and document their business and organizational needs, pain points, and strategic goals Conceptual solution design: translate requirements into high level solution architecture for presales communication Stakeholder alignment: act as the technical liaison, communicating solution design, architectural concepts and technical considerations to both technical development teams and non-technical business stakeholders Presales support: collaborate with sales and presales engineers to define scope, estimate effort, and contribute technical sections to proposals and statements of work Solution development Solution architecture development: develop and deliver complete solution architecture based on established design patterns and practices, considering infrastructure, systems, applications, data engineering processes, request flows, integration points, security models, and constraints. Implementation plan development: break down the solution architecture to actionable tasks and develop an implementation plan to establish the solution Technology selection: evaluate appropriate approaches, technologies, platforms, and third party tools to fulfill requirements that cannot be covered by Graphwise products Data and Knowledge Engineering Knowledge modeling: develop taxonomies and ontologies to model business domains, improve expressivity and interoperability of metadata Data engineering solution development: develop ETL and data engineering solutions to process data from different content and data management systems Knowledge graph development: develop enterprise knowledge graphs integrate data engineering and knowledge modeling implementations based on defined data architecture Product and service delivery coordination Project development: lead or oversee the execution of the solution implementation plan, with hands-on guidance and technical support to internal and client development teams Issue resolution: identify and resolve technical issues and coordinate internal support from development, delivery, infrastructure and research departments Customer support: provide 2nd level support to customers support requests following customer support processes Product support: collaborate with product teams to fulfil customer and internal requests Team enablement: support the development of training programs, operational processes and best practices Required Qualifications 3+ years of experience in roles related to software engineering, data engineering, technical consulting, data centric solutions development or solutions consulting Knowledge and experience in semantic web and knowledge graphs related technology domains Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical field Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts in simple business terms Analytical and problem-solving skills, ability to analyze complex problems and design effective technical solutions Technically creative and open-minded Qualifications that are an asset Prior experience in an IT consulting / professional services or client facing environment Experience with managing client communication and expectations Hands-on experience in disciplines such as system architecture, data architecture, software architecture, infrastructure Organizational skills to plan, estimate, prioritize, coordinate work and fulfill timelines. Effective interpersonal skills and experience with teamwork Domain knowledge in a specific industry (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail) Experience with Agile and DevOps methodologies and tools What We Offer A friendly and professional international team and working environment in a rapidly expanding tech and AI company An exciting and challenging but rewarding, stimulating and vibrant position in an agile, dynamic, diverse and expanding company working in the semantic technologies and artificial intelligence domains Exposure to the newest technologies in AI and knowledge graphs space A workplace in an organization that is committed to sustainability and responsible business practices Flexible working hours and benefits that reflect our belief that a healthy work-life balance is a key driver of efficiency Career development path, through training, hands-on experience, time for innovation, and many more State-of-the-art infrastructure Lunch and Christmas holiday vouchers And of course free tea, coffee, fruit and snacks at office We look forward to receiving your application and having you in our team! Graphwise welcomes applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender expression, age, disability, and other statuses. Our company culture as well as policies enforced by our active DEI Group work towards ensuring an inclusive workplace.

description: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer focused on AI integration and data pipelines to help build the next generation of GraphRAG and Graph Automation products . As Senior AI Engineer you will work at the intersection of knowledge graphs, LLM systems, and data orchestration , building scalable pipelines that power retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic enrichment, and automated knowledge workflows. If you enjoy building AI-driven backend systems, data pipelines, and production-grade LLM integrations , this role is for you. The Role: Design and implement GraphRAG pipelines that combine knowledge graphs with LLM-based retrieval systems Build scalable data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines for structured and unstructured data Integrate LLMs and embedding models into production systems (RAG, semantic search, agent workflows) Work with workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n) to orchestrate complex data and AI pipelines Build clean, production-grade APIs for AI and data services Optimize performance of retrieval, indexing, and transformation pipelines Ensure reliability, observability, and scalability of AI-driven backend systems Collaborate with product, data, and backend teams to design end-to-end AI features Collaborate with customer-facing teams and with Research on the research agenda Debug complex issues across distributed data and AI pipelines To filter applicants who do not read job descriptions, please submit, in your application form a valid JSON-LD string in the Address field (check https://json-ld.org/playground/) with your name and a link to your LinkedIn profile Your Profile: Must have-s: 4+ years of experience in backend or data engineering (Java, Python, or similar strongly typed language) Experience designing and building LLM pipelines, ETL workflows, backend data processing systems, and prompt engineering, including evaluationStrong understanding of APIs and backend system design A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches Hands-on experience with structured and/or unstructured data processing Experience integrating external services or APIs in production systems Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with complex data flows Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience Proficiency in English, both written and verbal Nice to have-s: Experience with RAG systems, LLM orchestration, or AI retrieval pipelines Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or semantic search systems Experience with n8n or similar workflow automation tools Knowledge of knowledge graphs, RDF, SPARQL, or GraphDB-like systems Experience with Elasticsearch / OpenSearch or other search indexing systems Exposure to LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows Experience with distributed systems and scalable data infrastructure Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and containerized deployments Experience in early-stage development – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications. What We Offer: A friendly and professional international team and working environment in a rapidly-expanding tech and AI company Exposure to the newest technologies in AI and knowledge graphs space A workplace in an organization that is committed to sustainability and responsible business practices An international workspace where more than 65% of colleagues come from across the globe. Our company culture as well as policies work towards ensuring we have an inclusive workplace.

As an Applied AI ML Lead within the Digital Intelligence team at JPMorgan, you will collaborate with all lines of business and functions to deliver software solutions. You will experiment, develop, and productionize high-quality machine learning models, services, and platforms to make a significant impact on technology and business. Additionally, you will design and implement highly scalable and reliable data processing pipelines, and perform analysis and insights to promote and optimize business results. Job Responsibilities Research, develop, and implement machine learning algorithms to solve complex problems related to personalized financial services in retail and digital banking domains. Work closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions and drive innovation in banking products and services. Collaborate with product managers, key business stakeholders, engineering, and platform partners to lead challenging projects that deliver cutting-edge machine learning-driven digital solutions. Conduct research to develop state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms and models tailored to financial applications in personalization and recommendation spaces. Design experiments, establish mathematical intuitions, implement algorithms, execute test cases, validate results, and productionize highly performant, scalable, trustworthy, and often explainable solutions. Collaborate with data engineers and product analysts to preprocess and analyze large datasets from multiple sources. Stay up-to-date with the latest publications in relevant Machine Learning domains and find applications for the same in your problem spaces for improved outcomes. Communicate findings and insights to stakeholders through presentations, reports, and visualizations. Work with regulatory and compliance teams to ensure that machine learning models adhere to standards and regulations. Mentor Junior Machine Learning associates in delivering successful projects and building successful careers in the firm. Participate and contribute back to firm-wide Machine Learning communities through patenting, publications, and speaking engagements. Required qualifications, capabilities and skills MS or PhD degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or Machine learning related field. Expert in at least one of the following areas: Natural Language Processing, Knowledge Graph, Computer Vision, Speech Recognition, Reinforcement Learning, Ranking and Recommendation, or Time Series Analysis. Deep knowledge in Data structures, Algorithms, Machine Learning, Data Mining, Information Retrieval, Statistics. Demonstrated expertise in machine learning frameworks: Tensorflow, Pytorch, pyG, Keras, MXNet, Scikit-Learn. Strong programming knowledge of python, spark; Strong grasp on vector operations using numpy, scipy. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills for problem solving. Excellent written and oral communication along with demonstrated teamwork skills. Demonstrated ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences Experience in working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating with other researchers, engineers, and stakeholders. A strong desire to stay updated with the latest advancements in the field and continuously improve one's skills Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills 8+ (MS) or 5+ (PhD) years of relevant experience. Deep hands-on experience with real-world ML projects, either through academic research, internships, or industry roles. Experience with distributed data/feature engineering using popular cloud services like AWS EMR Experience with large scale training, validation and testing experiments. Experience with cloud Machine Learning services in AWS like Sagemaker and Container technology like Docker, ECS etc. Experience with Kubernetes based platform for Training or Inferencing.

description: You’ll own data architecture solutions to deliver high-quality, governed, AI-ready data for business-critical applications and use cases. You’ll leverage AI to automate data architecture design workflows and deliver “Data Architecture as a Product”. If you enjoy turning complexity into clarity—and making data easier to discover, understand, and use—this role offers high visibility and strong growth opportunities. Job summary As a Lead Data Architect in our wealth management data architecture team, you define the conceptual, logical, and physical data models for domains and data products. You create and maintain data models, taxonomies, business glossaries, metadata, and a semantic layer so teams can build analytics and artificial intelligence solutions with confidence. You partner with stakeholders to align on canonical business concepts, stable identifiers, and clear definitions that make data easier to find, interpret, and govern. You help shape the target-state architecture by setting standards that enable interoperability and sustainable evolution over time. Job responsibilities • Engage engineering teams and business stakeholders to propose data-architecture approaches that meet current and future needs • Define the target-state data architecture for owned data products and drive delivery against the strategy • Participate in data-architecture governance forums and ensure alignment to standards and controls • Design and troubleshoot architecture solutions, applying creative thinking beyond routine or conventional approaches to solve complex technical problems • Own conceptual, logical, and physical data models for wealth management domains, including keys, relationships, and lifecycle states • Define canonical business concepts and relationships, including conformed dimensions and standardized measures (for example, assets under management and net flows) • Produce and maintain metadata artifacts (business glossary, taxonomy, semantic/context layer mappings, naming standards, modeling conventions) and embed them into data mesh delivery processes • Design for AI readiness: Ensure models support analytics/AI use: stable identifiers, entity resolution approach, history (SCD/event modeling), feature-friendly structures, and clear semantics for retrieval and grounding • Establish patterns for schema evolution, versioning, deprecation, and backward compatibility across platforms (warehouse, lakehouse, application programming interfaces, business intelligence) Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills • (Option A — regions where years are permitted) 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in data design for data products, data lakes, or data warehouses • (Option B — EMEA-style) Demonstrable experience in data design for data products, data lakes, or data warehouses • Advanced knowledge of data-product development lifecycles, design practices, and analytics within a domain-driven, data mesh paradigm • Demonstrable data modeling experience with ability to move from conceptual to logical to physical implementation • Practical cloud-native experience in designing and delivering data solutions • Experience defining and maintaining metadata (for example, glossary terms, definitions, and mappings) with governance discipline • Ability to partner effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into durable data designs • Familiarity with using automation or artificial intelligence tools to improve documentation quality, metadata coverage, or design workflows Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills • Experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization • Wealth management domain expertise, especially client onboarding and lifecycle processes (for example, customer relationship management, know your customer, onboarding, client servicing) • Strong data profiling and analytics fluency, including SQL skills • Experience with graph data modeling or graph database design • Risk and privacy awareness (for example, entitlements, data minimization, data classification) and ability to partner effectively with controls teams

description: Help shape how enterprise document management technology is evaluated, adopted, and governed at scale. In this role, you will build practical artificial intelligence tooling that makes governance faster, more consistent, and evidence-based. You will partner closely with platform engineers and architecture stakeholders to improve decision quality and reuse across the organization. Your work will directly influence platform standards, capability definitions, and technology assessments. As a Vice President Domain Intelligence Engineer in Document Management Platform, you own day-to-day domain governance and build intelligent tooling that scales how document management technologies are assessed and guided. You evaluate inbound technology requests, maintain the domain capability taxonomy, and identify gaps between demand and platform capabilities. You design and maintain a governed knowledge base and build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic workflows that accelerate assessments with documented, traceable outputs. You communicate recommendations clearly and support architecture forums with consistent, repeatable evaluation methods. Within the first 90 days, you will align key platform initiatives to documented capabilities, complete initial technology assessments using the standard rubric, and publish an initial knowledge base for platform engineering users. Within six months, you will deliver an automated triage workflow that matches requests to capabilities and produces draft, rubric-based recommendations to reduce turnaround time. Within 12 months, you will establish the knowledge base as the trusted reference for domain decisions and keep the capability taxonomy current and defensible for architecture and information security stakeholders. Job responsibilities Serve as the document management domain intelligence lead, owning technology preferences and decision guidance for the domain. Evaluate inbound technology requests (vendor, open-source, and internally developed), map requests to existing capabilities, and route items for further review when needed. Maintain and improve the domain capability taxonomy, ensuring capabilities are current, clearly described, and consistently classified. Identify capability gaps between platform offerings and engineering demand, and translate gaps into structured inputs for the platform roadmap. description: Job summary As a Senior Principal Data Architect at JPMorganChase within the IAM - Data Services Organization, you provide specialized expertise to influence the target state architecture and strategy. Work across teams to implement and advance the adoption of complex, strategic, global data architecture solutions that will give JPMorganChase a competitive advantage. You will build a Data Services platform that connects scattered assurance data into one governed model. That model runs from control objectives through to evidence, findings and verified closure. In 2027 it will prove few use cases on a shared data foundation and semantic model before scaling firmwide . We're looking for an architect who has designed, built and operated semantic models for large-scale applications. You will own the enterprise semantic model at the center of this platform. Job responsibilities Own the design of the enterprise semantic model. This means stable entity identities, typed relationships, constraints and versioning across the chain Control Objective → Procedure → Application → Platform → Evidence → Finding → Closure. Set and enforce firmwide standards for modelling, identity resolution, taxonomy and ontology. Work with function SMEs (for example IGA and PAM) to register domain taxonomies against a common core. Decide when to use graph-native processing and when to use lakehouse/SQL processing, for traversal, impact analysis and graph analytics at scale. Design how the semantic layer fits with the data lakehouse (Databricks bronze, silver and gold layers). That includes how gold contracts feed the graph and how lineage and provenance carry through. Define data contract and schema evolution patterns so changes never surprise consumers. Build point-in-time history into the model so audit evidence packs can be reproduced, and separate configuration evidence from operating evidence. Make sure every output carries entitlements, data minimization and quality state (freshness, coverage, completeness, and whether a value was observed, inferred or derived). This applies to dashboards, APIs, data shares and conversational access. Design deterministic, auditable context for AI agents, with clear control boundaries and human approval checkpoints. Guide producer teams on silver and gold modelling and contract design, and deliver the 2027 proof points. Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to senior technology, Risk and Audit stakeholders. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills A proven record of designing, building and operating semantic models or knowledge graphs for large-scale enterprise applications: many source systems, high-volume entities and relationships, and multiple consuming applications in production. Deep expertise in graph and semantic data modelling, covering entity and relationship design, ontology and taxonomy design, identity and entity resolution, constraint design, and temporal or bitemporal (point-in-time) modelling. Hands-on experience with graph technologies and query languages, such as a property graph or RDF/OWL. You understand where recursive SQL breaks down for traversal, cycles and graph analytics. Strong cloud-native data platform architecture experience, ideally on Databricks or another lakehouse with a bronze/silver/gold (medallion) layout. You can design how a lakehouse and a semantic layer work together. Experience setting and running data contracts, schema versioning and change management across many producer teams. A proven record of setting data modelling standards across many teams and products, and of influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority. Experience with lineage, provenance, data quality and completeness, and entitlement-aware access, including handling sensitive data (for example CCI) at the source. Experience leading safe adoption of firm-approved AI capabilities in data architecture workflows, including validation practices and awareness of data sensitivity. The ability to evaluate and govern AI-enabled architecture patterns, including agentic workflows, with clear control boundaries, auditability and human approval checkpoints aligned to resiliency and security expectations. The ability to evaluate current and emerging technologies and recommend data architecture approaches that reach the target architecture. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experience modelling controls, risk, audit or compliance data, such as control-to-evidence mapping, findings and remediation workflows, or continuous control monitoring. Familiarity with identity and access management data (IGA, PAM, entitlements, privileged access). Experience with metadata management, data catalogues, MDM, and lineage or provenance at enterprise scale. AI/ML enablement through graphs (feature generation, embeddings, relationship-aware retrieval or GraphRAG), with strong grounding in data controls. Experience building self-service data platforms (YAML/SQL-declared pipelines, automated deploys, guardrails, quotas and budgets). Experience at a regulated financial institution.

description: Join the Firmwide Technology Resiliency group within JPMorganChase’s Cybersecurity & Technology Controls organization. The group ensures the firm’s technology estate can maintain effective operations and sustain the critical functioning of Essential Business Services against an evolving threat landscape. Our work underpins the firm's ability to meet global operational resilience expectations, helping to show regulators, clients and the business that critical services can withstand and recover from severe but plausible disruption. We are seeking a Senior Lead Security Engineer to design and build product capabilities that operationalize the management of technology resiliency. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role: you will architect and write production code, set technical direction, and ship platforms consumed directly by operations and development teams across the firm. At the Senior Lead level, you are expected to own the technical strategy for a product area end-to-end - from problem framing and architecture through delivery, adoption, and operational ownership - while raising the engineering bar across adjacent teams. Job responsibilities Design, build, and evolve products that automate resilience management and give teams real-time insight into service health, dependencies, recovery readiness, and controls. Combine telemetry, configuration, topology, change, and control evidence to identify resilience risks. Automate resilience controls across software delivery, including policy checks, guardrails, evidence capture, and drift detection. Generate and validate recovery plans from infrastructure templates and deployed environments, refreshing them as environments change. Provide operational tools such as dashboards, control status views, exception and waiver workflows, recovery playbooks, and runbooks. Automatically capture auditable resilience evidence—including dependency maps, recovery testing results, and control compliance—to support operational resilience and regulatory commitments. Build data pipelines and models that represent service dependencies and resilience posture using graph-based approaches, including dependency graphs, blast-radius analysis, critical paths, and control coverage. Develop analytics to identify risk concentration, single points of failure, configuration anti-patterns, and recovery-readiness gaps. Apply site reliability engineering principles to improve product reliability, scalability, and operability through service level indicators and objectives, instrumentation, error budgets, and automation-first operations. Lead by doing: contribute significant code while driving design reviews, technical direction, and delivery discipline. Mentor engineers and raise standards across peer teams; partner with cyber operations, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, and risk stakeholders to define requirements, sequence delivery, and drive adoption. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 7 years of professional experience in security engineering, site reliability engineering, production engineering or support, platform engineering, infrastructure reliability, or a related field. Hands-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, or improving complex production environments, including building, shipping, or operating production systems. Knowledge of security practices for production technology, including access controls, service accounts, network or service segmentation, platform security, or secure operations. Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience developing scripts, automation, or data solutions for engineering or operational use. Experience with software or service design, including application programming interfaces, and with at least one additional programming language such as Rust, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript. Experience with cloud-native architecture, containers such as Docker or Kubernetes, and continuous integration and delivery practices. Experience using infrastructure-as-code tools, such as Terraform, to manage infrastructure, environments, or configuration changes. Understanding of secure software development practices and automated engineering controls in build and deployment pipelines. Understanding of high-availability and disaster-recovery patterns across cloud or hybrid infrastructure. Ability to explain technical designs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Cyber operations engineering background, including experience with security operations, cyber telemetry, detection engineering, cyber risk signals, or operational workflows. Data science or analytics experience, particularly with graph technologies such as Neo4j, TigerGraph, or Amazon Neptune, including graph data modeling, query patterns, dependency mapping, and visualization. Hands-on experience implementing policy-as-code or controls-as-code, including rules engines, pipeline gates, and automated evidence collection. Experience generating and maintaining recovery and resilience plans from real infrastructure state, including infrastructure-as-code and runtime discovery, and embedding plans into operational workflows; familiarity with resilience frameworks such as DORA, UK PRA/FCA operational resilience, U.S. Interagency Sound Practices, FFIEC, Basel Principles, or NIST CSF. Experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, to accelerate delivery and improve developer productivity. Proven ability to build collaborative partnerships with technical stakeholders, including technology vendor partners, and to work effectively in a matrixed organization. Experience building and operating observability stacks and telemetry pipelines, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards, and correlation and triage workflows; in-depth PaaS/IaaS virtualization knowledge, experience across multiple public cloud providers, or both.

description: About the Metropolitan Museum of Art The Met presents over 5,000 years of art from around the world for everyone to experience and enjoy. The Museum lives in two iconic sites in New York City—The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Cloisters. Millions of people also take part in The Met experience online. Since its founding in 1870, The Met has always aspired to be more than a treasury of rare and beautiful objects. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and respectful work environment with a staff as diverse as the audiences we engage. Our staff members are art lovers who are passionate about working toward a common goal: creating the most dynamic and inspiring art museum in the world. At The Met, every staff member – from security officers to researchers to scientists and beyond – lives by our core values of respect, inclusivity, collaboration, excellence, and integrity. Respect: Engage one another with collegiality, empathy, and kindness, always. Inclusivity: Ensure that all are and feel welcome and valued. Collaboration: Reach across boundaries to exchange ideas and work together toward our shared mission. Excellence: Lead the cultural world in quality and expertise—and inspire curiosity and creativity. Integrity: Hold ourselves to the highest moral standards, admit when we fall short, and then evolve. ABOUT WATSON LIBRARY Thomas J. Watson Library is The Met's research library. With its collection of more than one million volumes, extensive digital collections, and online resources, Watson Library is one of the world's most comprehensive art libraries. The library's holdings reflect the global and encyclopedic nature of The Met, with books ranging in date from the late fifteenth century to current scholarship, in all fields covered by The Met. The library's mission is to support the research activities of the Museum staff and to offer access and outstanding services to an international community of students and scholars. The staff of the Sherman Fairchild Center for Book Conservation are responsible for the preservation of Watson’s collection, and for other Met departmental collections. GENERAL STATEMENT OF RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES: This position performs original and complex copy cataloging adhering to current national and international standards (e.g., RDA, LCNAF, LCSH, PCC); engages in name authority record creation (NACO); contributes to the department’s continued engagement with reparative cataloging practices; and increases awareness, discoverability, and use of the library’s collections through publications, presentations, programs, digitization, and social media. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES: Applies specialized subject and metadata expertise, and performs original and complex copy cataloging of library material; Creates high-quality descriptive and technical metadata in MARC and non-MARC formats for physical and digital collections, including serials; Performs original and complex copy cataloging for print and electronic materials following RDA standards in all subjects collected by the library, including materials in Romance and other European languages; Creates and enhances LC/NACO records, and participates in linked data initiatives involving NACO, Wikidata, and other vocabularies; Creates TMS records for library material that is exhibited publicly; Plays a leading role in cataloging material from all Departmental Libraries, as well as managing projects related to the handling of Departmental Library projects; Increases awareness, discoverability, and use of the library’s collections through publications, presentations, programs, and social media; Contributes to the metadata creation of the library’s digital collections; Assists in coordinating the cataloging and processing of library materials by Watson staff, interns, and volunteers; Provides reference assistance and research support to Museum staff and visiting researchers in Watson, including 3-4 weekend days per year; Maintains a course of professional development through participation in professional associations or other professional activities external to the library, and brings best practices and innovative approaches to Watson Library; Other duties as assigned. REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS: ALA-accredited master’s degree in library or information sciences required; M.A. in Art History or significant experience working in the humanities preferred Five years’ experience in a professional position in a museum or academic library required At least five years of experience in original and complex copy cataloging, with demonstrated fluency in cataloging print, digital, continuing resources, and online resources required Experience with OCLC Connexion, MarcEdit, OpenRefine, and an integrated library system required Experience creating records in TMS preferred Experience creating and updating NACO records and coordinating linked data initiatives that involve NACO records preferred Experience with automated methods to improve or enhance bibliographic records and metadata at scale preferred Excellent instruction and communication skills, and the ability to provide high-quality reference services and to make presentations to a broad range of researchers from novice to advanced required Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders including curatorial and research staff, fellows, and local academic programs required Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish positive and productive collaborations with library colleagues and museum staff required Ability to plan, manage, and oversee multiple projects, meet deadlines, and prioritize work in alignment with the strategic goals of the library and the Museum required Ability to perform detailed work accurately and independently required Knowledge of cataloging and classification practices, standards, and schema such as MARC, RDA, AACR2, LCSH, and Program for Cooperative Cataloging standards (NACO, SACO, BIBCO) required Reading knowledge of at least one Romance or other European language; proficiency in a second and third language strongly preferred Experience with large cataloging projects preferred COMPENSATION: Pay Rate: $95,000 - $105,000 The advertised pay scale reflects the good faith minimum and maximum salary range for this role. The advertised pay scale is not a promise of a particular wage for any specific employee. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, special licensing or qualifications, and other factors. Location Requirements At time of employment, employees are expected to be located within commuting distance of the Museum. “Commuting distance” means that they are located in one of following states: New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, or Pennsylvania (the “Tri-state and PA” areas), and be able to commute to and from the Museum in a single day. Benefits Offerings The Museum provides competitive compensation, and generous benefits and perks for all eligible employees. Note: Benefits Offering may differ based on Employee Status. Medical, dental, vision and life insurance 403(b) basic retirement plan and optional matching retirement plan with an outstanding employer match Considerable paid time off, including annual leave, sick leave, and 13 Museum holidays Long-term disability coverage Flexible Spending Accounts & Health Savings Account (pre-tax income for eligible health care expenses) Commuter benefits (pre-tax income for parking or mass transit expenses) Free financial-planning services Financial assistance for relevant coursework, seminars, and training programs 25% discount for staff in Museum shops A subsidized staff cafeteria Access to the Museums Council pass, which grants free admission to various museums and cultural institutions We recognize that it is highly unlikely that someone meets 100% of the desired attributes for a role. If much of this job description describes you, then please apply for this role. The Met is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, The Met will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed in this process, please contact benefits@metmuseum.org . The Metropolitan Museum of Art provides equal opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, mental or physical disability, pregnancy, alienage or citizenship status, marital status or domestic partner status, genetic information, genetic predisposition or carrier status, gender identity, HIV status, military status and any other category protected by law in all employment decisions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, compensation, training and apprenticeship, promotion, upgrading, demotion, downgrading, transfer, lay-off and termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

description: 岗位名称： FDE实习生 - Accelerator Team 工作性质： 全职实习生 招聘人数： 1-2人 工作地点： 北京 组别简介 自创院以来，微软亚洲研究院 Accelerator Team致力于连接研究、人才、创新生态，以及不同国家与区域，构建开放协同的创新网络。该团队加速研究的同时推动创新从实验室走向真实世界，赋能微软亚洲研究院打造面向未来的 AI 创新生态。 当下，该团队致力于探索 AI-Native 的创新工作方式，并将前沿人工智能能力转化为可落地的应用与工具。团队聚焦大语言模型、AI Agent、检索增强生成（RAG）、工作流自动化及知识管理等方向，通过快速原型、真实场景验证和持续迭代，提升团队生产力、协作效率与组织创新能力。 工作职责 1. 与 Accelerator 团队紧密合作，围绕科研协作、人才发展、知识管理及组织智能等真实场景，设计并构建 AI Native 应用、智能 Agent 与自动化工作流，助力提升研究效率与创新能力。 2. 快速理解开放性问题，将复杂需求转化为可落地的 AI 解决方案，通过快速原型开发、持续实验与迭代验证，不断优化真实用户场景中的产品体验与价值。 3. 参与 AI Native 产品的全生命周期，包括需求分析、方案设计、技术实现、效果评估、部署优化及持续迭代，共同推动创新项目落地。 任职要求 计算机、工程或其他相关专业的本科、硕士或博士在读或者gap-year学生优先，同时欢迎具备相关能力和项目经验的跨学科同学申请。 具备良好的编程能力，熟悉至少一种主流编程语言，能够熟练运用 AI 辅助编程（Vibe Coding）完成原型开发，并具有实际项目经验。 乐于探索 AI-Native 的工作方式，能够快速学习和应用新工具、新技术与新框架，通过快速验证和迭代提升团队协作与工作效率。探索并应用前沿 AI 技术，包括大语言模型（LLMs）、AI Agents、多 Agent 协作、Context Engineering、RAG、Knowledge Graph、Memory、Tool Use 等，推动 AI 在科研组织中的创新应用。 具备良好的沟通与协作能力，能够理解开放性需求并将其转化为可落地的 AI 解决方案。 能够熟练使用英语作为工作语言。 能够获得导师的书面同意。 加分项（满足任意一项即可） • 有 AI Agent、Copilot、LLM 应用或 AI 自动化工具相关项目经验。 • 有使用 OpenAI API、Azure AI 或其他 AI 平台完成实际项目的经验。 • 有个人 AI 项目、Hackathon、开源项目或产品开发经验。 • 有 Workflow Automation、知识管理、数据分析或内部效率工具开发经验。 • 乐于尝试新技术，并能够快速将新的 AI 能力应用到真实场景中。 实习时间要求 能获得导师许可，并保证至少三个月的全职实习。 申请方式 请下载并填写申请表（ https://aka.ms/InternApplication ），并将申请表与完整的中英文简历（PDF/Word 格式）一同发送至 MSRAih@microsoft.com。邮件标题请注明： FDE实习生-Accelerator Team 了解更多“明日之星实习生计划”： https://www.msra.cn/zh-cn/connections/academic-programs/tomorrowstars

title: AI Solutions Architect

description: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision:  At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.   As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. Director, GraphAware Engineering The role We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Hume engineering: about 25 engineers in five product-aligned teams, plus the DevOps team, working across Europe. Hume is a graph-powered intelligence analysis platform. Analysts in law enforcement, customs, financial crime and national security use it to find the connections that matter in their cases. You will report to the Senior Director for GraphAware Products, who leads both product and engineering. You will work as a peer of the Director of Product Management.  You have two core responsibilities, and they matter equally. The first is the people: grow the engineering team in size, skills and knowledge, by hiring well and by coaching engineers into stronger engineers, tech leads and future leaders. The second is the system that lets those teams decide autonomously and deliver well: clear team ownership, sound decisions, predictable releases, secure practices and effective AI-assisted development. The two reinforce each other: a good system helps people grow faster, and people who grow keep improving the system. Engineering should not depend on a few individuals to resolve every architecture, release or staffing question, and that includes you. This is a leadership role. You will not write production code day to day. You need enough technical depth to earn senior engineers' respect, ask the right questions in a design review and diagnose a production incident. Then you hand the decision back to the people who own it. What you will own Teams and people. Lead, coach and grow the team leads and tech leads. Build management and senior technical career paths, hiring within the team, and plan succession so no area depends on one person. Delivery. Own engineering's organisation-wide commitments. Put in place planning, checkpoints and tracking that the teams run themselves, so risks and dependencies surface early. Release quality. Treat everything we ship as the product: installation packages, Helm charts, Docker Compose, configuration and documentation, tested on every deployment environment we support, including on-premises and restricted environments. Own the definition of done, code-review discipline and vulnerability mitigation within agreed targets. Secure engineering. Work with our Security & Compliance colleagues, who run the ISO 27001 programme, and make sure engineering practice meets it. Technical ownership. Be accountable for Hume's overall technical excellence: architecture, code quality, performance and security. Challenge and shape the major technical decisions together with the tech leads, and set how decisions are made, challenged and recorded. Delegate design to tech leads and principal engineers, and evolve the architecture so most changes need only one team. Set clear guidance on where AI-assisted development helps and where it doesn't. DevOps. Lead the DevOps team and own its priorities, balancing the teams' requests against platform improvements. How you will work You care about the problem we solve. Product owns what we build and why; engineering owns how and whether it is feasible. You care about the why as well. You understand how an investigation runs and what an analyst needs, and you join customer conversations to hear it first-hand. You bring trade-offs and alternatives to the Director of Product Management early, before commitments are made, so product and engineering plan as one. You are part of the Science & Technology team, as well as engineering's leader. You bring engineering's view into its decisions early and openly, and you challenge them, including your manager's. Once a decision is made, you own it with your teams and explain the reasoning behind it. You build trust in both directions: engineers know their view is heard, and the leadership team can rely on engineering's commitments. You communicate clearly, in writing first. You write updates people can act on, and decisions are recorded where everyone can read them. You explain difficult decisions plainly to engineers, to Neo4j colleagues and to customers. You bring decisions, not only questions. You own engineering's response to customers and the field. In practice that means three things. Customer escalations and production issues get a named owner, a response and follow-through to the fix. Deployment and support questions from field engineers and customers are answered within agreed targets. And the release dates and scope the field shares with customers are ones engineering has committed to, agreed with the product team. You are the escalation point when something is stuck. What you need to bring Experience leading an engineering organisation of about 20 or more people across several teams, through tech leads or engineering managers, accountable for both delivery and people. A strong background as a senior engineer and tech lead in backend, data or platform systems. You can review architecture across a JVM backend, a modern web front end, AI/LLM components and CI/CD. Experience reorganising engineering teams around product domains, using Team Topologies, strategic Domain-Driven Design or similar, and bringing people with you through the change. A track record of improving delivery, quality and release practices for a complex product that customers deploy themselves. Clear written and spoken communication in English, and experience leading distributed teams across countries. Nice to have Graph databases (especially Neo4j), knowledge graphs or GraphRAG. Building LLM-based or data-intensive products in production, and leading teams through adopting AI-assisted development. Products for law enforcement, government or other security-sensitive customers. Leading engineering through an acquisition or integration into a larger company. What this role is not Not the sole architect or a full-time coder: design belongs to the tech leads, and you make sure it is challenged and written down. Not the product owner: you shape what we build through partnership with the Director of Product Management, not by deciding it. evidence.phrase: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. Director, GraphAware Engineering The role We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Hume engineering: about 25 engineers in five product-aligned teams, plus the DevOps team, working across Europe. Hume is a graph-powered intelligence analysis platform. Analysts in law enforcement, customs, financial crime and national security use it to find the connections that matter in their cases. You will report to the Senior Director for GraphAware Products, who leads both product and engineering. You will work as a peer of the Director of Product Management. You have two core responsibilities, and they matter equally. The first is the people: grow the engineering team in size, skills and knowledge, by hiring well and by coaching engineers into stronger engineers, tech leads and future leaders. The second is the system that lets those teams decide autonomously and deliver well: clear team ownership, sound decisions, predictable releases, secure practices and effective AI-assisted development. The two reinforce each other: a good system helps people grow faster, and people who grow keep improving the system. Engineering should not depend on a few individuals to resolve every architecture, release or staffing question, and that includes you. This is a leadership role. You will not write production code day to day. You need enough technical depth to earn senior engineers' respect, ask the right questions in a design review and diagnose a production incident. Then you hand the decision back to the people who own it. What you will own Teams and people. Lead, coach and grow the team leads and tech leads. Build management and senior technical career paths, hiring within the team, and plan succession so no area depends on one person. Delivery. Own engineering's organisation-wide commitments. Put in place planning, checkpoints and tracking that the teams run themselves, so risks and dependencies surface early. Release quality. Treat everything we ship as the product: installation packages, Helm charts, Docker Compose, configuration and documentation, tested on every deployment environment we support, including on-premises and restricted environments. Own the definition of done, code-review discipline and vulnerability mitigation within agreed targets. Secure engineering. Work with our Security & Compliance colleagues, who run the ISO 27001 programme, and make sure engineering practice meets it. Technical ownership. Be accountable for Hume's overall technical excellence: architecture, code quality, performance and security. Challenge and shape the major technical decisions together with the tech leads, and set how decisions are made, challenged and recorded. Delegate design to tech leads and principal engineers, and evolve the architecture so most changes need only one team. Set clear guidance on where AI-assisted development helps and where it doesn't. DevOps. Lead the DevOps team and own its priorities, balancing the teams' requests against platform improvements. How you will work You care about the problem we solve. Product owns what we build and why; engineering owns how and whether it is feasible. You care about the why as well. You understand how an investigation runs and what an analyst needs, and you join customer conversations to hear it first-hand. You bring trade-offs and alternatives to the Director of Product Management early, before commitments are made, so product and engineering plan as one. You are part of the Science & Technology team, as well as engineering's leader. You bring engineering's view into its decisions early and openly, and you challenge them, including your manager's. Once a decision is made, you own it with your teams and explain the reasoning behind it. You build trust in both directions: engineers know their view is heard, and the leadership team can rely on engineering's commitments. You communicate clearly, in writing first. You write updates people can act on, and decisions are recorded where everyone can read them. You explain difficult decisions plainly to engineers, to Neo4j colleagues and to customers. You bring decisions, not only questions. You own engineering's response to customers and the field. In practice that means three things. Customer escalations and production issues get a named owner, a response and follow-through to the fix. Deployment and support questions from field engineers and customers are answered within agreed targets. And the release dates and scope the field shares with customers are ones engineering has committed to, agreed with the product team. You are the escalation point when something is stuck. What you need to bring Experience leading an engineering organisation of about 20 or more people across several teams, through tech leads or engineering managers, accountable for both delivery and people. A strong background as a senior engineer and tech lead in backend, data or platform systems. You can review architecture across a JVM backend, a modern web front end, AI/LLM components and CI/CD. Experience reorganising engineering teams around product domains, using Team Topologies, strategic Domain-Driven Design or similar, and bringing people with you through the change. A track record of improving delivery, quality and release practices for a complex product that customers deploy themselves. Clear written and spoken communication in English, and experience leading distributed teams across countries. Nice to have Graph databases (especially Neo4j), knowledge graphs or GraphRAG. Building LLM-based or data-intensive products in production, and leading teams through adopting AI-assisted development. Products for law enforcement, government or other security-sensitive customers. Leading engineering through an acquisition or integration into a larger company. What this role is not Not the sole architect or a full-time coder: design belongs to the tech leads, and you make sure it is challenged and written down. Not the product owner: you shape what we build through partnership with the Director of Product Management, not by deciding it. Location Based in Italy, Czechia, Spain, the Netherlands or the UK, working remotely with teams across Europe. Occasional travel for team gatherings, Neo4j and customers. Italy only: The gross annual salary (RAL) range for this role when based in Italy is €90.000-€110.000. Salary is set individually for each candidate, based on objective, gender-neutral criteria such as experience, skills and scope of responsibility. Contract under the collective bargaining agreement (CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria). This information applies to Italy only. For other countries, please speak with the recruiter. Why Join Neo4j? Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years. Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history. 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific , BT Group , Caterpillar , Cisco , Comcast , Department for Education UK , eBay , NBC News , Novo Nordisk , Worldline , and others . Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success. Countless industry awards . Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform. A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers. Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues. One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application. Neo4j Values: Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. The Role: We are aiming to hire someone in the the UK, Czechia or Italy. Product Engineering at GraphAware offers a unique opportunity to build real-world intelligence systems that matter. Build with purpose: Your code will help law enforcement and analysts save lives and protect communities through better data insight. Innovative tech: Work with knowledge graphs, workflow engines, LLMs, and graph-native UIs pushing the boundaries of data analytics. Shape the future: Contribute to product direction and technical vision alongside a senior engineering team. True autonomy: Own your work, from ideation to deployment.Global mindset: Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, data scientists, and product thinkers across Europe and beyond. Growth without bureaucracy: Develop your skills in a non-micromanaged, excellence-driven environment. What you will be doing As Tech Lead, you will own core parts of the platform layer of GraphAware Hume, our graph-powered analytics platform — the foundations that cut across every development group and that every feature team builds on. You'll be sought out across the organisation for technical guidance on graph architecture, and expected to anticipate issues at the product level before they surface. Neo4j sits at the heart of the product, we need someone who goes beyond using it well, and actively tracks new features, tests them against real workloads, and identifies where they can move the product forward. Working hands-on with Neo4j at the heart of the product, you will drive the architecture that lets us model, query, and scale the knowledge graphs our users depend on. Your responsibilities will include: Driving platform architecture, setting technical direction for the transversal foundations that feature teams across Hume build on, and shaping cross-cutting design decisions with the wider engineering group Owning our Neo4j strategy : actively tracking and hands-on testing of new releases and ecosystem tooling (GDS, APOC, etc.) to assess breaking changes, propose new product opportunities, and plan deliberate, scalable migrations.
